jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

**Real Estate, Planning, Design & Construction**

UCLA Health is one of the most advanced academic medical systems in the world, and the environments we build are as critical to our mission as the care delivered within them. We are seeking a Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment Project Coordinator to join our Real Estate, Planning, Design & Construction team, a professional who brings technical fluency in design and construction with the organizational discipline to drive projects from concept through closeout in one of healthcare's most complex and regulated environments.

In this role, you will independently manage small capital projects end-to-end while supporting Senior Project Managers with furniture and equipment on priority initiatives exceeding $1M. You will serve as a key liaison between contracted vendors, consultants, and UCLA Health clients, coordinating design, construction, FF&E procurement, regulatory compliance, and move planning across a dynamic portfolio of concurrent projects.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain and develop the PDC Resource Library, manage vendor relationships, vet new products, and support the department's Standardization Program
* Manage the full FF&E program, coordinating with clients, vendors, and manufacturers through procurement, delivery, installation, and punch list resolution
* Lead small capital projects through all phases, from scoping and design through plan check, bidding, construction, and fit-up/move-in, with full ownership of budgets, schedules, and client communication
* Navigate plan check and back-check processes through Campus Building Official and HCAI (OSHPD) approval, and manage all associated documentation and inspector visits
* Oversee construction activities including contractor schedules, pay applications, and utility and fire alarm shutdowns to maintain an operational facility
* Ensure all project closeout documentation, including warranties, record drawings, and O&M manuals, meets contract requirements and is transferred to the appropriate entity

**Salary Range:** $38.65 – $80.70 per hour.

**Target Salary Range: $39.00 - $45.00 per hour**

  
Pay range: $38.65 - $80.70 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 1 to 2 years of professional experience in design, construction, or FF&E
* Working knowledge of healthcare construction regulations including HCAI (OSHPD), California Building Code, Title 22, and ADA/accessibility standards
* Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and deadlines
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with clinical, administrative, and vendor stakeholders

**Preferred**

* Experience managing projects within a healthcare or academic medical center environment
* Familiarity with UCLA standards, UCOP Capital Programs processes, and Job Order Contracting
* Experience with FF&E procurement and move coordination in a large institutional setting
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit, and intermediate skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and Bluebeam

jobs.title: Operations Project Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

**GFT** is seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our Shared Services team in Long Beach, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring regular attendance in Long Beach, CA.

**What you’ll be challenged to do:**

The Operations Project Coordinator II provides project management, administrative, and accounting support to project teams, particularly for large, complex, and high-risk clients/projects, in collaboration with Project Accounting.

**In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:**

* Prepares fee proposal templates, draft contracts, and subcontracts for review.
* Ensures projects adhere to contract language and requirements; issues and tracks project amendment documentation and coordinates for review.
* Develops WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) and Project Authorization forms including budgets and client invoicing requirements.
* Monitors project financials including variance, revenue, budgets, and WIP; responsible for follow up on revenue variance issues; participates in resolving issues.
* Partners with Collections Specialist to aid in project cash flow from clients.
* Serves as a liaison between internal staff, suppliers, and clients while communicating effectively on behalf of Project Managers.
* Conducts pre-bill reviews with Project Managers as necessary.
* Participates in monthly project review meetings and collaborates with Business Operations teams.
* Assists Business Operations with analysis of project budget performance.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

**Education | Experience:**
---------------------------

**What you will bring to our firm:**

* Bachelor's degree in related field or 4+ years of relevant experience in project accounting, project controls, proposals, or contracts.
* 2+ years of relevant experience in project controls, proposals, or contracts.
* Knowledge or awareness of financial and general accounting, business math, AR, AP, and related processes.
* Industry terminology knowledge such as client contracts, awards, procurement, overhead, fee types, and multipliers.
* Desire to learn and apply industry key concepts such as effort, revenue, and variance analysis.
* Ability to manage assignments efficiently.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, multitask, and adapt to changing priorities.

**Compensation: $70,000 - $80,000, Salary dependent upon experience and geographic location**

### **Featured Benefits:**

* Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.
* Comprehensive benefits package, including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
* Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
* Competitive paid time off (PTO) accrual.
* Tuition reimbursement for continued education.
* Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations.
* Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

**Company Overview:**
---------------------

At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. We measure our success by the strength of our relationships – that’s why we’re the employer of choice for 5,000+ of the industry’s brightest engineers, planners, architects, inspectors, designers, and more.  
  
Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. Backed by over a century’s experience, together we’re building a lasting legacy for future generations: stronger communities, a healthier planet, and better lives. **GFT: Ingenuity That Shapes Lives™**

GFT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veterans’ status or other characteristics protected by law.

*Unsolicited resumes from third party agencies will be considered the property of GFT.*

Location: Long Beach, CA  
Working Hours: 8 AM – 5 PM  
Employment Status: Full-time

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Department of Medicine, Division of Pulmonary Medicine is seeking a Program Coordinator to support and oversee operational, programmatic, and research activities for the expansion of the 3 Wishes Program beyond UCLA. This interdisciplinary initiative enhances end-of-life care by fulfilling meaningful wishes for patients and their families, supporting bereavement services, and partnering with clinical teams to promote compassionate, humanistic care. The Program Coordinator will coordinate program operations, communications, outreach, and strategic initiatives that further the program's mission.

Hourly range: $30.63-$59.19

  
Pay range: $30.63 - $59.19 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**  
Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2-4 years of relevant experience.
* Ability to work independently and also have interpersonal skills to work with teams.
* Demonstrated writing skills to produce wide range of documents and deliverables.
* Experience communicating effectively and professionally and working with a variety of internal and external partners, including UCLA administrators, outside funders, policy makers and community representatives.
* Working knowledge of evaluation, creating datasets, grant writing and proposal submission.
* Strong organizational skills to successfully work on and track complex programs involving short deadlines and multiple tasks, in coordination with multiple teams to achieve program/project mission and goals.

jobs.description:
Please go to http://www.hacla.org/careers for details of this position and to apply.
  
  
**Special Note:** The posted salary is an estimate of the potential annual pay. Final offer will be dependent on qualifications and experience.
  
  
\*\*\*Position is open until filled\*\*\*

**SUMMARY:** Under general direction this position is responsible to plan, organize, coordinate, implement and evaluate one or more assigned functions or program areas such as digital inclusion & literacy, child care, youth development, fund raising and sponsor identification, community and cultural arts, recreational services, family and senior services, or other assigned functions; conducts administrative studies and analysis to solve problems of budget, organization, program, procedure, employee utilization, capital projects or equipment; service coordination, develops and recommends program guidelines, standards, procedures, policies and protocols; develops schedules, priorities, reports and standards for achieving program goals.
  
  
This position will oversee the utilization and programming of the Housing Authority’s Computer Labs and other public spaces to be centers for learning, engagement, wellness and positive activity; develop and implement best practice programmatic and capital investments to improve functionality and outcomes; seek out and nurture partnerships with other organizations to leverage resources and bring consistent, meaningful programs and opportunities to residents of public and affordable housing. This position will participate in a team focused on people-based strategies to impact the economic, health and educational trajectories of Housing Authority residents.

**PRINICIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES****:**
  
Meets and contacts a wide variety of community partners promoting and implementing programs for Housing Authority clients. Must also assist the staff of Housing Authority in establishing and maintaining program services. Acts as a liaison for the Housing Authority; meets with representatives of various agencies, community groups, and service providers in coordinating services provided to Housing Authority clients, confers with staff on program problems and resolves issues and problems; prepares and reviews reports on the effectiveness of program activities and prepares executive briefings, special and annual reports. Prepares program budget requests; develops Request for Proposals (RFP)/scope of work for procurement of client services; administers contracts with outside service providers; prepare and administer grant proposals. Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with a variety of individuals, community groups, service providers, sponsors, and agencies; conduct and attend meetings to provide information, enlist support, resolve issues, and plan/coordinate activities. Participate with a variety of Housing Authority committees, study groups, and task forces; attend a variety of meetings including staff and departmental meetings. Participates in collaborative meetings and acts as a liaison to communicate with partners and HACLA. Prepare and make oral and written presentations before Board of Commissioners, committees, community groups, professional groups and other agency bodies to coordinate, improve, and stimulate interest in the program and to secure financial support. May supervise and evaluate the performance of assigned staff; prepare and/or oversee the preparation of training, operational manuals, educational materials and information of assigned program areas; also be able to perform related duties as required.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES****:**
  
Requires knowledge of principles and practices of public and business administration, social services programs, including organization, personnel and fiscal management, and program management; statistical and research methods;; oral and written communication skills; applicable sections of federal, state and local rules, regulations, and laws; technical aspects of assigned functions and program areas; public speaking; budget preparation and administration; and supervision. Knowledge of community outreach and engagement is preferred with experience working with large collaborations and/or contract teams.
  
  
Ability to coordinate and perform a variety of complex administrative and staff duties; develop working technical knowledge of a variety of unrelated areas quickly and accurately; work independently with little direction; establish and maintain effective working relations with others; meet schedules and timelines; plan, develop and administer programs; research data and prepare reports; communicate effectively both orally and in writing; work confidentially with discretion; present ideas and concepts persuasively in speaking before groups or writing for publication; interpret, apply and explain laws, codes, regulations, policies, and procedures; analyze situations accurately and adopt effective course of action; supervise assigned staff and work collaboratively in a team environment.  
  
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**
  
Any combination of education and experience that is equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in public administration, business administration, social work or a closely related field, and three (3) years of increasingly responsible experience in a professional program administration experience including at least one year in field of assignment.
  
  
**Special Requirement:** Must possess current valid California driver's license.

Applications will be reviewed for relevant experience, education, and training. Applications must be detailed and complete for proper evaluation. jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs
* Organizing and distributing materials (e.g., homework and readings) to students through
* undefined
* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

jobs.title: Agency Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Konnect:**

Konnect Agency is an independent PR and communications agency helping brands build awareness, relevance, and momentum. Our work brings together earned media, creator partnerships, experiential marketing, social media, and compelling storytelling.

**The Opportunity:**

We're looking for a strong writer and highly organized Agency Marketing Coordinator to help bring Konnect's work, people, and perspective to a broader audience.

You'll connect the dots across our social channels, newsletter, website, award submissions, and marketing materials, making sure great work becomes compelling content and reaches the right audience.

Working with agency leadership and teams across the business, you'll gather stories, write copy, coordinate assets and approvals, and keep our marketing calendar moving. You should enjoy both finding the story and doing the follow-up needed to get it published.

**What You'll Do:**

**Write and develop content**

* Work with the social and digital teams to gather and help edit social posts, newsletters, website copy, agency announcements, case studies, and marketing materials.
* Turn campaign results, team insights, and agency milestones into clear, engaging stories.
* Support executive thought leadership by developing draft posts and articles from leadership's ideas.
* Adapt stories for different audiences and channels while maintaining a consistent Konnect voice.
* Check facts, results, names, and details before content goes live.

**Connect social, email, and website marketing**

* Maintain one editorial calendar across Konnect's marketing channels.
* Coordinate with social and creative colleagues to develop, approve, and publish content.
* Help produce the agency newsletter, including story selection, copywriting, asset collection, testing, and distribution.
* Keep website news, case studies, and team information current.
* Extend the life of strong content: turn a campaign success into a case study, newsletter feature, social series, and award opportunity.

**Coordinate awards and industry visibility**

* Research relevant agency, campaign, and leadership awards.
* Maintain a calendar of deadlines, requirements, entry fees, and submission status.
* Draft award entries and collect supporting results, visuals, and information from account teams.
* Coordinate reviews and approvals so submissions are accurate and on time.
* Help identify speaking opportunities, agency profiles, and other ways to showcase Konnect's expertise.

**General agency needs**

* Proactively gather campaign wins, coverage, photos, videos, and results from teams.
* Maintain an organized collection of approved marketing assets.
* Set clear internal deadlines, follow up on missing information, and flag obstacles early.
* Support updates to agency credentials, capabilities materials, and case study libraries.
* Track content performance, newsletter engagement, website traffic, and relevant inquiries; recommend practical improvements.

**What you'll bring**

* Approximately 3 years of relevant experience in marketing, communications, PR, journalism, or content.
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with samples that demonstrate your ability to tell a clear story.
* Strong organization and the ability to manage several deadlines at once.
* Confidence following up with colleagues at every level and moving work through approvals.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Instagram, email marketing platforms, and content scheduling tools.
* Comfort using Canva and collaborating with designers on graphics and simple video content.
* Initiative, curiosity, and sound judgment about what makes a story interesting.
* Comfort using AI tools to support your work, paired with strong editorial judgment and careful fact-checking.

This is a hybrid in-office role with 3 days/week in one of Konnect's hubs (Los Angeles, Chicago). Previous Agency experience in a commensurate role and award submission experience is preferred. As part of the consideration process, applicants will be asked to submit 2-3 writing samples; ideally including social copy, a newsletter, case study, article, or award entry.

Konnect Agency is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About IW Group**

IW Group is the leading multicultural advertising and marketing agency with offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and New York. Named **Ad Age’s 2025 Multicultural Agency of the Year** and recognized by **PRWeek** for Best in Multicultural Marketing, IW Group produces culture-shaping campaigns for global and national brands.

IW Group drives impactful work by blending storytelling, cultural insight, and innovation to achieve measurable results. We represent multiple brands and deliver distinctive multicultural and cross-generational campaigns.

**The Role**

We’re seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Post Production Coordinator to join our Production team. Working closely with the Post Production Producer, you’ll support all facets of post production across multiple clients—from editorial and finishing to versioning, translation, trafficking, and final delivery.

You’ll help keep projects moving, assets organized, and teams aligned so every deliverable reaches the right destination, on time and to specification. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who thrives in a fast-paced creative environment and wants to deepen their understanding of agency post production and multicultural content.

**What You’ll Do**

* Support the Post Production Producer with project schedules, status updates, production documentation, and day-to-day coordination across multiple client projects.
* Coordinate voiceover recording sessions with talent agencies, recording studios, voiceover talent, language coaches, and internal teams, including scheduling, session logistics, and follow-up on audio deliverables.
* Assist with SAG-AFTRA talent and non-union talent administration, including talent contract requests, talent estimate request forms, session reports, completion reports, and related documentation.
* Maintain accurate talent records and assist with tracking usage terms, expiration dates, renewals, and associated talent costs.
* Support production budgeting and administration, including vendor estimates, talent estimates, purchase orders (POs), invoices, and project expense tracking.
* Coordinate with editors, motion designers, audio teams, and external post-production vendors to track assets, revisions, schedules, and finishing milestones.
* Maintain deliverable matrices and version trackers covering different formats, cutdowns, languages, graphics, legal copy, and platform requirements.
* Coordinate translation and localization workflows with language partners and internal reviewers, including scripts, voiceover, subtitles, captions, and on-screen text; track approvals and implementation.
* Organize review links, consolidate feedback, and track creative, client, and legal approvals to ensure teams are working from the correct versions.

Procurement Coordinator

**Be the Connection That Keeps Our Supply Chain Moving**

Osiopack is looking for a highly organized, proactive Procurement Coordinator to join our team in Anaheim.

This isn't a position where you'll simply issue purchase orders and update spreadsheets. You'll play an important role in keeping our international supply chain moving, communicating directly with overseas suppliers, monitoring production, coordinating shipments, resolving issues, and helping ensure our customers' orders arrive accurately and on time.

You'll serve as a key liaison between our U.S. team and our overseas manufacturing partners. If you're someone who enjoys staying on top of details, solving problems before they become bigger problems, and keeping multiple moving pieces organized, we'd like to meet you.

**What You'll Do**

As our Procurement Coordinator, you will:

* Communicate regularly with overseas suppliers regarding purchase orders, production schedules, invoices, priorities, and shipments
* Track open purchase orders from placement through production and delivery
* Monitor production status, lead times, and potential schedule risks
* Coordinate expedited orders and help resolve delays before they impact customers
* Obtain quotations and assist with supplier sourcing and purchasing negotiations
* Prepare and maintain purchase orders, RFQs, shipping documentation, supplier correspondence, and internal documentation
* Review supplier proposals, purchase orders, invoices, receipts, and related documents for accuracy

* Help identify and resolve purchasing, production, documentation, and logistics issues

**What We're Looking For**

Our ideal candidate is:

* Bilingual in English and Korean speaking, reading, and writing **strongly preferred**
* Experienced in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or a related field
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple open orders simultaneously
* Detail-oriented and able to catch documentation or scheduling errors
* A strong communicator who is comfortable working with international suppliers
* Proactive, you don't simply report a problem; you help find the solution
* Comfortable following up persistently when information or action is needed
* Able to prioritize urgent requirements while maintaining accuracy
* Comfortable working across multiple departments
* Proficient with email, Microsoft Word, and Excel

**The Person Who Will Succeed Here**

You don't wait until a delivery is late to ask where it is.

About Hollywood Park  
  
Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke, it stands as the largest urban mixed-use development currently under construction in the Western United States. The vibrant "city within a city" features sophisticated residences, a dynamic outdoor retail and lifestyle district, creative office spaces, public parks, and a scenic lake. Anchored by the world-class SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater, with Hollywood Park Studios and a luxury boutique hotel forthcoming, the district creates the ultimate Live, Work, Play environment.  
  
Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3.1 million-square-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. A proven global leader that consistently ranks among the world’s top venues in ticket sales, the stadium has already hosted iconic events like eight FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, Super Bowl LVI, the 2023 College Football National Championship, WrestleMania 39, the CONCACAF Gold Cup Final, and numerous record-breaking concerts. SoFi Stadium is set to host the Super Bowl LXI in 2027, the Olympic and Paralympic Opening Ceremonies for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (LA28), along with being converted into the largest swimming venue in history.  
  
Adjacent to the stadium and under the same sweeping translucent roof canopy sits the 2.5-acre open-air American Airlines Plaza and the 6,000-seat YouTube Theater. As an intimate, state-of-the-art venue, YouTube Theater hosts a diverse line-up of chart-topping superstars, iconic comedy acts, awards shows, esports competitions, community gatherings, and corporate conferences. Named the “Top West Coast Club or Theater” by Billboard, YouTube Theater is a must-play destination.  
  
Culture  
Hollywood Park is being brought to life by a deeply experienced team of creative forward-thinkers. The project is a celebration of all that Los Angeles has to offer. We are inspired by our diverse Inglewood community as a place for the community to be, to see and to connect.  
  
Hollywood Park is committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our team members, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.  
  
At the heart of Hollywood Park, lies our dedication to our purpose, promise, and commitments. Our PURPOSE is creating extraordinary experiences, one moment at a time. Our PROMISE is to be an iconic destination that celebrates our diverse and vibrant community. We promise to exceed expectations while cultivating a fun and safe experience where lasting memories are made. Our COMMITMENTS are outlined by S.T.A.R.S.  
  
Our S.T.A.R.S. commitments are enabled by five foundational principles:  

* Start with Care – create a lasting impact through genuine care
* Thrive as a Team – create an environment of collaboration and encouragement
* Anticipate Unspoken Needs – be proactive in delivering extraordinary service and supporting others
* Resolve with Respect – treat others with empathy, patience, and kindness
* Safety Always – maintain a safe and secure environment.

  
As the People Operations Coordinator, You Will…  
  
The People Operations Coordinator supports day-to-day HR processes across the employee lifecycle. Reporting to the Head of Payroll & Total Rewards, this role ensures accurate HRIS data management, onboarding administration, and consistent People Operations workflow support.  
  
More Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To…

* People Operations & HRIS Support
* Process employee lifecycle transactions, including new hires, job changes, compensation updates, and terminations.
* Maintain HRIS workflows to ensure timely and accurate updates across systems.
* Generate recurring and ad hoc HR, payroll, and people operations reports (e.g., headcount, status changes, turnover, payroll exceptions).
* Support documentation and SOP maintenance for People Operations functions.
* Identify process improvement opportunities to streamline HR workflows.
* Coordinates company events, lunches, and celebrations as well as managing our employee recognition programs.
* Sourcing and ordering high-quality corporate gifts, milestone awards, and company swag, ensuring our team feels valued, connected, and motivated.

Onboarding & Offboarding Administration

* Coordinate administrative components of new hire onboarding, including HRIS setup, E-Verify, I-9 compliance, and system access requests.
* Prepare and distribute onboarding materials and ensure new hire documentation is completed accurately.
* Coordinate offboarding steps, collect company property, close out system access, and update HRIS/Payroll systems accordingly.
* Support background checks, credential verification, and onboarding compliance steps.

Compliance, Documentation & Audits

* Maintain accurate personnel files and ensure compliance with retention and regulatory requirements.
* Support internal HR, payroll, and audit activities (I-9 audits, payroll reconciliations, garnishment setup, etc.).
* Assist in managing compliance training assignments and tracking for operational departments.
* Ensure consistent adherence to federal, state, and local employment regulations.

You're a Great Fit for Our Team If You Have…

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 1 to 3 years of related administrative or HR experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and/or Google Workspace.
* Experience with HRIS systems such as Paycor or Workday is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, proactive mindset, and the ability to maintain confidentiality with sensitive HR data.

jobs.title: Office Manager & Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
Hybron is an advanced manufacturing company that is building lightweight composites at mass production scale. At Hybron, we have pioneered a new composites manufacturing process that enables complex, high-performance composite parts to be produced 10-100 times faster than traditional manufacturing, at a fraction of the cost.  
  
We recently closed an oversubscribed $25M seed round, are backed by the Northrop Grumman Technology Accelerator, and are rapidly growing to commercialize and mass produce composite products at a scale never seen before. Our current focus is applying our proprietary process to composite artillery shells, solid rocket motor nozzles, gas turbine engine components, and airframes.  
  
If you want to join a rapidly growing company working on cutting edge composites technology while building capabilities for the warfighter and reshoring U.S. manufacturing, then we want to speak with you.  
  
**About the Role**  
This is a full-time, in-person role at our Hawthorne facility. As you will be working at an early-stage deep tech startup, this role will span many different tasks. Along with these high expectations comes the opportunity to significantly influence the development, strategy, and trajectory of a fast-growing startup company. Your work will tangibly impact our company and the composites industry, and you will be able to make rapid professional gains in an environment that encourages growth and innovation.  
  
This is a hands-on role. About half of your time will go to running the office and facility: vendors, supplies, visitors, shipping & receiving, and the systems that keep a growing, security-conscious team productive and compliant. The other half goes to supporting our leadership team: calendars, travel, reservations, expense reports, meetings, notes, filings and the details that let them stay focused on customers, investors, and the team. You’ll report to our CEO and work closely with our leadership team. You’ll also support the company as a whole with company-sponsored events and swag, as well as people functions such as onboarding and offboarding.  
  
This role requires a high-trust, self-starting generalist. You are a great fit if you can operate with autonomy in high-energy, fast-growing companies, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are great at juggling several responsibilities. You excel in prioritizing the important things, and are able to protect focus time on executives’ calendars. If you are highly organized, discreet, and calm under pressure, who take ownership and enjoy building systems in a fast-moving startup, we want you.  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* U.S. Person status pursuant to the EAR and ITAR definitions.
* 3+ years of experience in office management, executive assistance, or administrative operations, ideally at a startup or in another fast-paced environment.
* Available to work full-time, Monday–Friday, in person at our Hawthorne facility.
* Exceptional proactive organization and follow-through: you keep many details moving at once and close every loop.
* Excellent prioritization skills, knowing what is urgent and what is important.
* Sound judgment and discretion with confidential, sensitive, and export-controlled information, knowing when to take action and when to ask for clarity.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with employees, executives, vendors, and visitors.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, and quick to learn new software.
* Calm, service-minded, and resourceful under pressure.

  
**Nice to Haves**

* Experience in a defense, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment, including familiarity with ITAR, CMMC, or visitor control.
* Experience managing facility, IT, or security vendors and service contracts.
* Accounts payable, bookkeeping, or spend-management tool experience.
* Event planning experience.

  
**Growth Opportunity and Targets**  
As you grow with Hybron, your responsibilities are expected to shift and evolve:

* Build out our workplace as we scale: lead facility expansions and new sites, and own the facilities budget and vendor contracts.
* Hire and lead a small office and facilities team (front desk, facilities, and admin support) as headcount grows.
* Extend your support to new executives as the leadership team grows.
* Take on conference and trade show logistics, including registrations, travel, and shipping booth materials.

  
**Compensation and Schedule**

* $70,000 - $95,000 per year
* Significant stock options in the company
* Potential additional compensation
* Mondays – Fridays in-person

  
**Benefits**

* Paid time off
  + Vacation – 10+ working days per year
  + Sick – 5 working days per year
* Hybron observes a generous company-official holiday schedule
* Daily lunches provided by the company
* 401(k) with employer-matched contributions up to 4% of salary
* Healthcare benefits
  + Medical insurance – 95% EE, 75% DEP employer contribution
  + Dental insurance – 95% EE, 75% DEP employer contribution
  + Vision insurance – 95% EE, 75% DEP employer contribution
  + Life, short and long-term disability insurance – 100% company covered

  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**  
Pomelo is a boutique NYC-based staffing company. We began as an offshore recruiting firm and have recently evolved into an executive search firm that places top-tier US-based business generalists (former consultants and investment bankers) in operating roles at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. We work with some of the fastest-growing tech companies and iconic consumer brands, from New York to San Francisco.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
We are building a pool of exceptional Executive Assistant / Executive Business Partner candidates for opportunities at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. EAs work closely with founders, CEOs, and executive teams to drive high-priority initiatives, solve complex business problems, and help the company operate more effectively. This is a highly cross-functional role that can span strategy, operations, special projects, business development, finance, and organizational planning. We are specifically looking for candidates with a strong business generalist background, particularly former management consultants or investment bankers who have demonstrated exceptional analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. As opportunities arise, selected candidates will be considered for EA roles that match their experience, interests, and career goals.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the right hand to the executives for all administrative and operational tasks, helping the executives save time and resources
* Manage/organize email inboxes and calendars for the executives, including prioritizing calls/meetings based on business needs and scheduling travel/itineraries as requested
* Proactively follow-up with timely reminders and to-do lists
* Set the agenda and discussion points/topics for the executives' meetings
* Act as the main point of contact for various projects, including corresponding with third-parties, coordinating and prioritizing meetings, and organizing events from start to finish
* Lead, manage, and oversee project timelines, budgets, and resources
* Create knowledge bases, SOPs, and other documents based on business needs
* Actively listen to executives' feedback and gather insights to constantly identify opportunities for business improvement
* Handle basic financial tasks such as expense tracking, invoicing, budgeting, and reimbursement
* Ensure that all deadlines are met and all work is produced in a timely manner
* Perform ad hoc administrative, business operations, and special project tasks as needed
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leadership and help ensure key priorities continue moving forward

  
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **2-4 years of experience at a top-tier management consulting firm or investment bank required**
* Exceptional candidates may have additional experience at a high-growth startup, technology company, or other operating environment
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems with limited direction
* Excellent analytical, financial modeling, and quantitative skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders.
* Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
* Bachelor's degree from a strong academic institution
* Willingness to work in NYC, San Francisco, Los Angeles, or other major startup hubs depending on the specific opportunity

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will vary by company, seniority, and location. Typical EA opportunities in our network offer competitive base salary and bonuses.

Pomelo works directly with candidates throughout the search process to identify opportunities that align with their background, career goals, and interests.

***Full-time, Union Position***

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Description:** Femmes Against Violence (FAV) is an 18-week, cohort-based program that promotes healing, agency, leadership, and self-determination among youth ages 14–21, including femme-identified and gender-expansive youth of color. Offered twice annually, FAV engages youth three days per week through culturally affirming, gender-responsive, youth-centered programming.

The program integrates intersectional, liberatory frameworks grounded in Black feminist theory, Indigenous teachings, ancestral knowledge, collective care, and community accountability through interactive workshops, experiential activities, community outings, guest speakers, and youth-led action projects. Programming explores identity, culture, relationships, gender-based violence prevention, systems of power and oppression, and pathways toward personal and collective well-being. Youth develop critical consciousness, leadership, advocacy, communication, and self-determination skills while engaging in opportunities to apply their learning through creative and experiential activities.

FAV also provides a wraparound support model that connects youth to mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources. FAV creates a supportive space where youth can build belonging, strengthen their voices and leadership capacity, develop healthy coping and relationship skills, and envision and pursue futures grounded in care, justice, and self-determination.

* Facilitate culturally and gender-affirming trainings, workshops, group activities, presentations, and community outings for FAV participants.
* Support youth in developing and implementing creative projects, presentations, educational materials, and other activities that promote awareness, leadership, advocacy, and positive community engagement.
* Work collaboratively with other Horizons programs to ensure a cohesive program model and coordinated services for participating youth.
* Advocate for FAV participants and support access to appropriate services, resources, and opportunities.
* Communicate regularly with participants regarding program participation, needs, progress, and available resources.
* Cultivate and maintain working relationships with schools, community-based organizations, government agencies, SFUSD Wellness Centers, Community Health Outreach Workers, and other appropriate partners to recruit and enroll youth and maintain a strong referral network.
* Network and participate in community committees, meetings, and collaborative efforts that promote FAV, strengthen partnerships, and expand resources and opportunities for participants.
* Coordinate with participants and staff to implement evaluation and feedback tools that measure program effectiveness, participant satisfaction, and progress toward program outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and timely program records, participant documentation, data, reports, and budgets, including required entries into the agency's CMS and GMS system.
* Facilitate connections to wraparound and support services, including mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, individual supervision, and other internal meetings that support effective program delivery and professional development.
* Complete required agency and funder trainings and maintain knowledge of applicable program standards, policies, and funding requirements.
* Participate in at least one agency-wide committee, project, or working group annually.
* Attend agency and funder meetings, quarterly All Grantee meetings, and other meetings that support programmatic integration within the agency and broader community.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by the Program Director.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in psychology, women’s or ethnic studies and/or a closely related field, and/or comparable experience to meet this requirement (2+ years).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience working with self-identified young women of color who have been system-impacted.
* Direct knowledge regarding youth development and empowerment principles, intervention strategies, best practices in serving system-impacted youth, harm reduction, etc.
* Experience coordinating after-school, leadership or other youth programming.
* Extensive knowledge of gender-based violence intervention strategies, sexual assault, domestic violence a must.

jobs.title: Community Manager (San Francisco)
jobs.description:
Hey! We’re team Granola We’re building the leading AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings, a product that’s spreading through teams and redefining how knowledge is captured and used. We help teams turn messy call notes into structured insight, so they can spend more time focusing on what’s important and less time on admin.

**Why we care about community**
-------------------------------

When people find Granola, they tend to really love it. Community is how we bring that feeling offline, into a room with other people who feel the same.

We’ve run 100+ events with more than 5,000 people, starting in London, and learnt a lot about what makes people come back.

In SF, we’ve opened an office and run a number of events, experimenting as we go: our GTM Series, a demo night with Linear, a GTM hackathon with Anthropic and more. Now we’re looking for someone to take it beyond the experimental phase and build a well-oiled machine, known as one of the best places in SF for tech community and events.

We don’t measure community in signups. It’s brand marketing, and it’s how we show people what Granola is like in person.

### **Our goal**

Make Granola one of the best AI-native, human brands for professionals.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

You’ll own generating event ideas and community initiatives and the execution those ideas:

* Come up with event and community ideas, and think hard about what makes an event special
* Curate the guest list so a great group of people show up
* Own all comms with speakers, partners and guests
* Run logistics like a station master, so everything leaves on time
* Own the marketing for every event, from the copy to the socials, so the room is full
* Work closely with our brand and events teams in London, who hold the bar on how Granola shows up
* Pitch in on big product launches when we need all hands
* Build relationships with the top accelerators and VCs in the Bay (e.g. YC, Neo, HF0, SPC). Be there when new cohorts land, so Granola is the first tool founders reach for on day one

**How you’ll know it’s working**
--------------------------------

* Within 6 months, people in SF say Granola puts on some of the best tech events in the city
* Before that:

  + Your events fill up are oversubscribed with the relevant folks for each event
  + Great event and community ideas keep coming
  + You own and run logistics like clockwork

**About you**
-------------

**Your background**

* 5+ years in community and events, venture, startup ecosystems or partnerships
* A track record of running great events for a tech audience consistently
* Comfortable talking to execs and founders

**Bonus points**

* A strong network in Bay Area tech, with relationships across founders, accelerators or VCs

**As a person, you**

* **Work autonomously.** You set direction together with Shre and the team, then run with it. Take feedback well - you get curious, adjust quickly, and show the change in your next piece of work
* **Sweat the details.** For every event, you think about the one thing that will make people remember it and feel special. You treat the attendee experience like a user flow: from the moment someone arrives outside our office, to checking in, to knowing where the bathroom is before they have to ask
* **Get startups and tech.** You’re always reading, listening and learning about the fastest-growing startups, founders and operators, and you know what founders care about
* **Have great judgment.** You come up with original ideas and have the instincts to know what’s right for Granola’s brand. Our bar is high, and you’re always open to learning how to meet it
* **Roll up your sleeves.** This is a founding community role. You’re as comfortable emailing a unicorn founder as you are Ubering to a restaurant yourself to pick up pizza boxes if DoorDash is horrendously late to make sure everyone’s fed. No task is beneath you
* **Love being around people.** You get energy from meeting people, can work a crowd, and can say no politely but firmly
* **Embody the core Granola traits:** hardworking, kind and incredibly ambitious

**Compensation**
----------------

Base salary: $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, plus equity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart’s demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together.

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

**Company Description**

SGS is the global leader and innovator in inspection, verification, testing and certification services. Founded in 1878, SGS is recognized as the global benchmark in quality and integrity. With over 97,000 employees in 130 countries and operating a network of more than 2,400 offices and laboratories, we provide services to almost every industry by assuring quality and safety of products and services.

Trusted all over the world, SGS is a market leader because we put 100% passion, pride and innovation into everything we do. We encourage new ideas. We welcome people who challenge the way we do things. And we will be 100% committed to helping you reach your full potential.

 **Job Description**

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically credible account manager who can build long-term customer relationships while also actively creating new business opportunities.

This person does not need to be a hands-on test engineer, but should be comfortable discussing technologies such as PCIe, USB, and Ethernet etc with engineering customers, understanding their challenges, and connecting those needs with the appropriate testing or engineering services.

Experience in the test & measurement or independent testing laboratory industry would be a significant advantage, particularly for candidates who already understand the Silicon Valley semiconductor and electronics ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

* 5–8 years of experience in technical sales, account management, business development, or a related customer-facing role within the electronics, semiconductor, test & measurement, or engineering services industry.
* Proven experience in managing and growing technical customer accounts, including developing relationships with engineering teams, engineering management, and procurement/business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and develop new business opportunities within both existing and prospective accounts. The role is expected to include approximately 30% business development / new opportunity creation in addition to account management responsibilities.
* Working knowledge of high-speed digital interfaces such as:
  + PCI Express (PCIe)
  + USB / USB4
  + HDMI
  + Displayport
  + Ethernet, and so on

The candidate is not expected to be a test engineer, but must have sufficient technical understanding to engage effectively with engineering customers, understand their product development and testing needs, and identify relevant business opportunities.

* Ability to understand customer product development cycles and translate technical requirements into appropriate testing, validation, compliance, interoperability, or engineering service opportunities.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and business audiences.
* Self-motivated and comfortable working in a role that combines account ownership with proactive business development.
* Ability and willingness to travel to customer sites within the Bay Area and occasionally outside the region as required.

Highly Preferred

* Previous sales or account management experience with a test laboratory, test & measurement equipment manufacturer, semiconductor company, or related engineering services organization.
* Existing relationships or experience working with semiconductor, computing, data center, networking, automotive, or consumer electronics companies in Silicon Valley.
* Familiarity with industry compliance and certification ecosystems such as PCI-SIG, USB-IF, Ethernet/IEEE, or other high-speed interface standards organizations.
* Experience selling technical services or solutions involving electrical compliance testing, protocol testing, interoperability testing, validation, or high-speed signal integrity.
* Demonstrated track record of growing existing accounts while developing new customers or new business within existing customers.

The expected salary for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 per year This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.description:
**Location**: Swayable is hybrid in-office 3x a week!

Swayable is a fast-growing AI and automated data science platform that measures public opinion, and the impact of messages and advertising content on it. We are a 50-person team backed by top technology and social impact investors, including Y Combinator. Founded in 2018 by physics PhDs, it is led by the former Executive Director for Digital Strategy at the New York Times. Clients include major consumer-facing brands (JP Morgan Chase, Airbnb, Paramount Pictures), technology companies (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon), academic researchers (MIT, Yale, Stanford) and mission-aligned civic advocacy campaigns (e.g. on climate, human rights and elections). Check our our values & culture deck to learn more: https://tinyurl.com/4zjchwzs

Joining Swayable means being on a team whose work changes the course of history. The technology we develop is at the leading edge of transforming some of the world's most important campaign organizations and enterprises: combatting disinformation, protecting democracy, and supporting the sustainable growth of consumer-facing brands.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a driven, resourceful Sales Development Representative to open doors at some of the world's most influential brands. Based in San Francisco and reporting directly to our Chief Revenue Officer, you'll identify prospective customers, earn their attention, and turn initial conversations into qualified sales opportunities.

This is an opportunity to build your sales career with direct access to an experienced revenue leader and meaningful ownership from day one. You'll learn how enterprise deals get built, sharpen your commercial instincts, and have a visible impact on Swayable's growth. You should be excited by the daily work it takes to get there: researching accounts, picking up the phone, testing messages, and following through when the first attempt doesn't land.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build pipeline:** Generate qualified sales opportunities through consistent, thoughtful outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
* **Find the right people:** Research target accounts and identify decision-makers across marketing, consumer insights, brand strategy, and creative teams.
* **Make outreach relevant:** Connect Swayable's capabilities to a prospect's business, priorities, and challenges, giving them a compelling reason to engage.
* **Qualify opportunities:** Lead initial conversations to understand prospective customers' needs and set the sales team up for productive next steps.
* **Improve the approach:** Work directly with the CRO to test messaging, refine targeting, and turn what you learn into a more effective prospecting process.
* **Own your execution:** Keep accurate CRM records, manage follow-ups, and take accountability for activity, qualified meetings, and pipeline goals.

**Who You Are**

* You have 1–2 years of professional experience, ideally in sales, business development, recruiting, or another role that requires proactive outreach and persistence.
* You're ambitious and self-motivated. You set a high bar for yourself and want your effort to translate into measurable results.
* You're willing to do the work. Cold calls, repeated follow-ups, and the consistency required to build pipeline are part of the challenge you're signing up for.
* You're a quick study who can understand a technical product, ask smart questions, and explain its value in clear, engaging language.
* You communicate confidently and concisely, whether you're writing an email or speaking with a senior marketing leader.
* You're resilient and resourceful. When an approach isn't working, you look for ways to improve and keep going.
* You actively seek feedback and put it into practice. You're excited to learn directly from the CRO and take increasing ownership as you develop.
* You're organized, dependable, and comfortable moving quickly in a startup environment.

**Benefits**:

* 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Plans - no employee contribution required
* Generous PTO
* Equity Options
* 401k plan, FSA
* Ongoing professional development investments

jobs.description:
### **TRELLIS BUILDS AND DEPLOYS SELF-IMPROVING AGENTS TO GET PATIENTS ACCESS TO LIFE-SAVING MEDICINE.**

Our AI agents process billions of dollars worth of therapies annually with patients in all fifty states. We do this by automating document intake, prior authorizations, and appeals at scale to streamline operations and accelerate care. We classify medical referrals, understand chart notes, and automate contract and reimbursement search to provide patients with accurate coverage determinations and cost responsibility. Think of us as the infrastructure behind how patients get their medications.

Trellis is a spinout from Stanford AI Lab and is backed by leading investors including YC, General Catalyst, Telesoft Partners, and executives at Google and Salesforce.

### **THE ROLE**

We're hiring two Sales Development Representatives to help build our growth team. You'll be the first conversation many healthcare leaders have with Trellis. Your job is to find the right people, start great conversations, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. You'll work closely with our GTM Engineer and AEs, and report to Mike Barbour (VP of Sales).

This role is built for early-career people with a steep learning curve. You'll learn how specialty pharmacies, infusion centers, provider groups, and health systems get patients on therapy, and you'll have a clear path to grow into a closing role.

Compensation: The pay range listed is on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and commission.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Respond to inbound:** Follow up quickly on inbound interest and qualify new leads
* **Run outbound:** Reach operations, revenue cycle, and pharmacy leaders through email, phone, and LinkedIn
* **Book qualified meetings:** Own a meetings target and hand AEs well-researched opportunities
* **Use AI tools:** Work with our GTM Engineer's tooling (Clay, HubSpot, sequencing, LLMs) to research accounts and personalize outreach
* **Keep the CRM clean:** Log activity and keep accounts and contacts up to date in HubSpot
* **Share what you learn:** Feed objections, messaging, and market insight back to sales and marketing

### **ABOUT YOU**

You're driven, curious, and competitive. You're not afraid of a cold call, you bounce back from a no, and you want to learn as fast as possible. You like understanding how things work and you take ownership of your number.

### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* 0-2 years of experience in sales, business development, recruiting, or another target-driven role
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Resilience, organization, and a bias for action
* Comfort learning new tools quickly; experience with AI tools is a plus
* Interest in healthcare or health tech is a plus
* Must be able to work in our San Francisco office

### **WHY WORK WITH US**

* **Real impact at massive scale:** We serve patients in all fifty states and are scaling to hundreds of healthcare locations. Every meeting you book can lead to more patients starting therapy sooner.
* **Incredible growth and traction:** We've grown revenue 10x in the past few months alone.
* **Work with the founding team:** Partner directly with founders and F500 customers, alongside healthcare operations leaders who have overseen 50+ locations.
* **Be at the forefront of AI in healthcare:** Work on production-grade agentic systems that make critical healthcare decisions, not a demo.
* **World-class team:** Join teammates who have won international physics olympiads, published economics research, were founding engineers at unicorn startups, and taught AI classes to hundreds of Stanford graduate students.

Compensation Range: $94K - $114K

**ABOUT US**  
Pomelo is a boutique NYC-based staffing company. We began as an offshore recruiting firm and have recently evolved into an executive search firm that places top-tier US-based business generalists (former consultants and investment bankers) in operating roles at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. We work with some of the fastest-growing tech companies and iconic consumer brands, from New York to San Francisco.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
We are building a pool of exceptional Executive Assistant / Executive Business Partner candidates for opportunities at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. EAs work closely with founders, CEOs, and executive teams to drive high-priority initiatives, solve complex business problems, and help the company operate more effectively. This is a highly cross-functional role that can span strategy, operations, special projects, business development, finance, and organizational planning. We are specifically looking for candidates with a strong business generalist background, particularly former management consultants or investment bankers who have demonstrated exceptional analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. As opportunities arise, selected candidates will be considered for EA roles that match their experience, interests, and career goals.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the right hand to the executives for all administrative and operational tasks, helping the executives save time and resources
* Manage/organize email inboxes and calendars for the executives, including prioritizing calls/meetings based on business needs and scheduling travel/itineraries as requested
* Proactively follow-up with timely reminders and to-do lists
* Set the agenda and discussion points/topics for the executives' meetings

* Lead, manage, and oversee project timelines, budgets, and resources
* Create knowledge bases, SOPs, and other documents based on business needs
* Actively listen to executives' feedback and gather insights to constantly identify opportunities for business improvement

* Perform ad hoc administrative, business operations, and special project tasks as needed
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leadership and help ensure key priorities continue moving forward

  
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **2-4 years of experience at a top-tier management consulting firm or investment bank required**
* Exceptional candidates may have additional experience at a high-growth startup, technology company, or other operating environment
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems with limited direction
* Excellent analytical, financial modeling, and quantitative skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders.
* Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously

* Bachelor's degree from a strong academic institution
* Willingness to work in NYC, San Francisco, Los Angeles, or other major startup hubs depending on the specific opportunity

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will vary by company, seniority, and location. Typical EA opportunities in our network offer competitive base salary and bonuses.

Pomelo works directly with candidates throughout the search process to identify opportunities that align with their background, career goals, and interests.

jobs.description:
ASAP Academic Program Specialist (Academic ASAP Student Advisor)

**POSITION DETAILS**

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017) and the Brookings Institution (2020). Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.

Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps motivated community college students earn degrees as quickly as possible, with a goal of graduating at least 50% of students within three years. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full-time study, mandatory tutoring, and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid-eligible students and free use of textbooks and monthly Transportation support for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP About ASAP Labor & Employment Law

PREFERRED QUALIDICATIONS

* Experience supporting community college students.
* Experience coordinating tutoring or academic support programs.
* Understanding of barriers facing urban community college students.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with student information systems and data.
* Microsoft Office proficiency (Excel, Access, Word).
* Ability to analyze data and prepare reports.
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments.
* Ability to facilitate workshops or trainings.

Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps students earn their college degree as quickly as possible, by removing the financial, academic, and personal obstacles that many students confront. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full-time study and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid eligible students, yearly textbook vouchers, and MetroCards for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP.

**Harlem Children’s Zone (HCZ),** a world-renowned education and poverty-fighting organization based in New York, seeks an enthusiastic, dedicated, and mission-aligned **Community Coordinator.**

For more information, check out Want to Work at Harlem Children’s Zone? Here are 7 Things You Need to Know.

**Who You Are:**

The Community Coordinator will bring a passion for Harlem Children’s Zone's mission: breaking the cycle of intergenerational poverty with comprehensive, on-the-ground programming that builds opportunities for children and families to thrive in school, work, and life.

The Community Coordinator plays a vital role in fostering engagement, strengthening program implementation, and enhancing community partnerships within HCZ’s multi-generational community center. Serving youth, adults, and seniors, this role builds trusted relationships with participants and families, supports high-quality program delivery, and ensures that community voices are heard and reflected in the center’s activities. The Coordinator collaborates closely with program and leadership staff to promote consistent attendance, develop partnerships, and track outcomes aligned with HCZ’s mission of breaking the cycle of poverty.

### **1. Family & Participant Engagement**

* Build meaningful connections with youth, adults, and senior participants.
* Serve as a primary liaison between the community center and families.
* Conduct outreach and maintain regular communication through phone calls, in-person meetings, and events.

### **2. Attendance and Retention Support**

* Track daily and weekly attendance across all program areas.
* Identify and address barriers to consistent participation.

* Develop and sustain partnerships with local organizations, service providers, and community leaders.

* Offer input on program design and lead portions of programming when needed.
* Coordinate program logistics and maintain organized tracking of deliverables and timelines.

### **5. Data Tracking and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of attendance, engagement, and referral outcomes using designated systems.
* Prepare monthly reports and present findings to leadership.
* Use data to drive continuous program improvement.
