jobs.title: US Account Manager E-Commerce
jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th century’s most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: *“Don’t undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.”*  
  
In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

**The Role**

As the Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding Polaroid's footprint across independent retailers, distributors, resellers, and e-commerce marketplaces. We are looking for an experienced account manager with strong business acumen, execution skills, and a deep understanding of retail and online sales channels to deliver profitable customer growth and increase market share.

This role will be responsible for managing key reseller and distributor relationships, supporting marketplace growth initiatives, monitoring channel compliance, and protecting the integrity of the Polaroid brand across retail and e-commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have experience with Amazon and other online marketplaces, retail channel management, MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance, listing optimization, and the Photo Specialty retail channel.

In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Focus on growing and developing existing customers while identifying and securing new business opportunities across retail, reseller, distributor, and marketplace channels.
* Manage the total account relationship, including new business acquisition, customer retention, expansion opportunities, and strategic account planning.
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with distributors, resellers, and specialty photo retailers to achieve sales and profitability goals.
* Achieve revenue, profit, and market share targets for assigned accounts and strategic channel partners.
* Lead new market penetration initiatives and optimize existing channel performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to plan and execute product launches, promotions, events, and marketing initiatives that drive sell-through and maximize ROI.
* Conduct product and assortment planning with retail and online partners to drive mutually beneficial business results.
* Create and maintain sales forecasts and demand plans to support business planning and inventory management.
* Analyze sales, inventory, and market trends to recommend pricing, assortment, and promotional strategies.
* Monitor sell-through performance and implement corrective actions as necessary.
* Set up, maintain, and optimize product content, imagery, and merchandising assets across retailer and marketplace portals.
* Monitor listing health, content compliance, product availability, and brand representation across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Ensure all marketplace listings comply with Polaroid brand guidelines, content standards, and retailer requirements.
* Monitor and enforce MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance across reseller, distributor, and online marketplace channels.
* Protect and monitor retail and e-commerce channels to identify unauthorized sellers, pricing violations, diversion, and brand integrity concerns.
* Manage and support marketplace reseller relationships to ensure compliance, profitability, and sustainable growth.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve content, inventory, operational, and fulfillment issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2-5 years of account management, sales, e-commerce, or channel management experience.
* Familiar working with Amazon and other major online marketplaces.
* Experience managing distributors, resellers, and specialty retail accounts.
* Strong knowledge of MAP compliance, channel management, and brand protection best practices.
* Understanding of marketplace listing health, product content optimization, and digital merchandising.
* Experience in consumer electronics, photography, imaging, or Photo Specialty retail channels preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, forecasting, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and account management tools.

**AI in our hiring process**

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

**Our Approach to AI**

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.

Compensation Range: $95K - $120K

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Fabuwood is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to own and execute the company's digital marketing programs across CRM and email, paid media and other digital channels.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy, execution, coordination, and analysis. The Digital Marketing Specialist will manage day-to-day CRM and email activity, oversee paid advertising, coordinate with internal teams and external partners, and continuously improve performance across the digital customer journey.

The role reports to the Digital Marketing Manager and owns the respective digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard. Success requires strong follow-through, reliable reporting, and the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations and next steps.

***Schedule: M-Th 8:00AM-5:00PM. F 8:00AM-12:00PM***

**Key Responsibilities**

CRM & Email Marketing

* Own the day-to-day management and execution of Fabuwood's CRM and email marketing program in HubSpot.
* Plan, build, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns, including newsletters, product communications, promotions, event follow-up, onboarding, nurture, and re-engagement programs.
* Manage audience segmentation, lists, workflows, automation, personalization, lead routing, and lifecycle stages to ensure communications are relevant and timely.
* Monitor deliverability, engagement, conversions, list health, and campaign performance; use testing and analysis to continuously improve results.

Paid Media

* Lead the day-to-day management and oversight of paid digital media, whether executed internally or through agency and vendor partners.
* Support campaign strategy, audience targeting, budgets, creative requirements, landing pages, tracking, optimization, and reporting across channels such as Google, Meta, YouTube, display, and other relevant platforms.
* Review performance regularly and make recommendations to improve efficiency, lead quality, conversion, and return on marketing investment.

Metrics, Scorecard & Optimization

* Own the digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard, including the accuracy, timeliness, definitions, targets, and reporting cadence for each assigned metric.
* Maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering accountable activity.
* Analyze performance by audience, campaign, channel, and funnel stage to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities.
* Translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans for the Digital Marketing Manager and broader marketing team.
* Work with internal stakeholders and partners to improve tracking, attribution, data quality, and reporting consistency.

Planning & Cross-Functional Execution

* Develop digital channel plans that support product launches, dealer initiatives, A+D programs, events, brand campaigns, and lead-generation goals.
* Manage digital marketing timelines, priorities, budgets, vendors, and deliverables, escalating risks or performance concerns when needed.
* Collaborate closely with creative, content, project management, sales, IT, and other teams to keep campaigns aligned and moving forward.
* Stay current on platform changes, digital best practices, privacy requirements, and emerging opportunities relevant to Fabuwood's audiences.

**Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of hands-on digital marketing experience across CRM/email, paid media, analytics, or related channels.
* Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform, including email creation, segmentation, workflows, reporting, and database management.
* Experience managing or overseeing paid media campaigns and interpreting performance across major advertising platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to maintain scorecard metrics, build clear reports, identify meaningful insights, and recommend next steps.
* Understanding of campaign tracking, conversion measurement, attribution, audience segmentation, and funnel performance.
* Excellent project-management, organizational, and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain performance clearly to both marketing and non-marketing stakeholders.
* A proactive, accountable mindset with strong attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Looker Studio, and social media management or reporting tools.
* Familiarity with lead nurturing, A/B testing, and marketing attribution.
* Experience working with agencies, media partners, freelancers, or other outside vendors.
* Experience in cabinetry, building products, home improvement, manufacturing, or a dealer-based business model is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means Fabuwood's digital marketing programs are well planned, consistently executed, and clearly measured. CRM and email campaigns are timely and targeted, paid media are actively managed, digital projects move forward, and performance data is accurate and easy to understand.

The Digital Marketing Manager and broader team can rely on the Digital Marketing Specialist to own the details, surface meaningful insights, recommend improvements, and follow through on the actions needed to strengthen digital performance.

jobs.description:
*Hey there, it’s Bram, the Director of Sales Development at Carv. I know the application process can often feel impersonal, so I wanted to leave a quick note on why you should consider joining Carv. Besides the fact that we’re an AI company offering a strong SDR salary and great benefits, we’re also an early-stage business.*  
  
*That means things move fast: direction changes constantly, and what you sold today might be obsolete tomorrow. In my eyes, that’s the best environment to truly learn* sales.  
  
At *Carv, SDRs have regular conversations with founders, but also a team and leader (me) dedicated to their success.*

#### **Major Benefits**

* Base Salary is between $65,000 - $75,000 with OTE up to $105,000+
* 100% Medical Coverage
Company trip to Amsterdam coming in December

#### **Carv’s Mission**

Simply to make human recruiting again. AI is a major buzzword, we understand that and while its a very competitive market we think by augmenting recruiters to do more candidate focused work we can fundamentally change the way Recruiting is done by Enterprise level companies.

#### **Day to Day**

For the most part, SDR’s remain the same, Cold Calling, Emailing, Prospecting, LinkedIn - We believe the difference is in the margins, while being consistent and organized are major pluses creativity is essential for an early stage company. Some of our recent initiatives include delivering bagels to local prospects in person, going to trade shows and conferences, sending champagne to new job starters, and soon we will be sending cameo’s to prospects — All of these were SDR driven and you have the same chance to make an impact in this way.

#### **Challenges**

It’s not all roses though, we understand that. We are in a challenging environment, one where AI is EVERYWHERE and we are trying to do one of the toughest things you can do in sales - break into the US market. This job isn’t for the faint of heart but if you can be successful in a bootstrapped startup your value increases dramatically for the future.

#### **Who you are**

Someone with strong business acumen that is quickly able to understand our prospects and the value proposition of Carv. The people who thrive in this role know how to balance their time between structured repetitive tasks and creative initiatives that move the needle with high level enterprise accounts

#### **Additional Benefits**

* Unlimited PTO
* Company Stock Options
* Work laptop
* Personal Development Budget

**Location:** New York and Ohio

**Compensation:** Commission-Based | Uncapped Earning Potential

About AisleRx

AisleRx is bringing innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies, helping pharmacy owners expand their service offerings and capitalize on new opportunities in the evolving healthcare marketplace.

We are seeking ambitious, self-motivated Independent Sales Representatives to introduce AisleRx to independent pharmacy owners and decision-makers throughout New York and Ohio.

This is an opportunity to represent an innovative healthcare solution, build relationships with local business owners, and earn commissions by helping pharmacies discover new ways to serve their customers.

The Opportunity

Are you a natural relationship-builder who enjoys connecting with business owners, opening doors, and turning conversations into business opportunities?

As an AisleRx Sales Representative, you will be responsible for identifying independent and regional pharmacies, establishing relationships with pharmacy owners, presenting the AisleRx solution, and developing opportunities for new business.

This is a **1099 independent contractor position paid on commission, with no guaranteed base salary**. It is ideal for a driven sales professional who values independence, flexibility, and the opportunity to grow earnings through results.

You will have the opportunity to leverage your existing professional network, develop new relationships in the pharmacy industry, and help independent pharmacies explore innovative healthcare solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Develop new business:** Identify and engage independent pharmacies that may benefit from AisleRx's telehealth solution.
* **Build owner relationships:** Connect directly with pharmacy owners, pharmacists-in-charge, and other key decision-makers.
* **Present AisleRx:** Clearly communicate the value proposition and explain how the solution may benefit independent pharmacies.
* **Generate sales opportunities:** Prospect, conduct outreach, schedule meetings, deliver presentations, and follow up with prospective customers.
* **Develop a territory:** Build a pipeline of qualified pharmacy prospects within your assigned geographic area.
* **Drive new partnerships:** Work with interested pharmacies to advance opportunities and convert prospects into customers.
* **Represent AisleRx professionally:** Build trust through knowledgeable conversations, consistent follow-through, and a customer-focused approach.

What We're Looking For

We are interested in people who are entrepreneurial, persuasive, professional, and motivated by results.

**Ideal candidates will have:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical sales, healthcare sales, medical device sales, or B2B sales.
* Existing relationships with independent pharmacy owners or other healthcare decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* The ability to prospect independently, generate leads, and develop new business.
* A self-starter mindset and the discipline to manage your own schedule and sales pipeline.
* A professional, consultative sales approach focused on understanding customer needs and communicating value.

**Especially attractive candidates include:**

* Former or current pharmaceutical and medical sales representatives.
* Individuals with established relationships in the independent pharmacy market.
* Pharmacy industry professionals with strong business development skills.
* Experienced B2B sales professionals who know how to reach decision-makers and close business.
* Independent sales agents looking to add an innovative healthcare solution to their portfolio.

Experience in pharmacy or healthcare sales is preferred, but proven sales ability and strong industry relationships are also valuable.

Compensation & Earning Potential

This is a commission-only, 1099 independent contractor opportunity designed for individuals who want their earnings to reflect their sales performance.

* **Commission-based compensation:** Earn commissions for qualifying sales under the AisleRx commission plan.
* **Uncapped earning potential:** Your earnings can grow as you develop your territory and generate new business.
* **Flexible schedule:** Manage your prospecting and sales activities independently.
* **Territory development:** Build relationships and a network of independent pharmacies in your market.
* **Meaningful opportunity:** Help independent pharmacies explore innovative solutions in a changing healthcare landscape.

There is no guaranteed base salary or hourly wage. Earnings will depend on sales results and the terms of the commission agreement.

Why Join AisleRx?

Independent pharmacies are an important part of their communities, and they need innovative solutions to remain competitive and meet evolving customer needs.

By representing AisleRx, you can help pharmacy owners discover new opportunities while building your own sales business.

If you have the relationships, drive, and ability to open doors, this is an opportunity to turn your sales experience into a rewarding business development opportunity.

Apply Today

If you are a motivated sales professional with a passion for healthcare, strong relationship-building skills, and the drive to succeed in a commission-based environment, we want to hear from you.

Join AisleRx and help bring innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies across New York and Ohio.

**AisleRx — Building partnerships with independent pharmacies.**

jobs.title: Retail Inventory & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Wolford**

Wolford represents the epitome of luxury and innovation in legwear and bodywear. With a rich heritage of knitting expertise and a global presence, we are committed to delivering exceptional quality, unmatched comfort, and a tailored customer experience. We empower our teams to exceed expectations, foster innovation, and contribute to the growth of a timeless, desirable brand.

**Join the World of Wolford — and help shape our future.**

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Retail Operations Coordinator is based at 609 Madison Avenue and is primarily responsible for the accurate and timely processing of shipments and merchandise movements across Wolford’s New York City boutiques. This hands-on role keeps merchandise organized, accurately recorded, and ready for the sales floor, allowing store leaders and brand ambassadors to focus on clients and selling.

Alongside NYC shipment responsibilities, the coordinator supports inventory accuracy, store standards, and operational processes across all Wolford boutiques in the US through inventory monitoring, process follow-up, and training support. The role partners closely with the Director of Retail, field leaders, and store leaders to identify issues, coordinate corrective actions, and maintain consistent operational standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**NYC Shipments and Merchandise Processing**
--------------------------------------------

* Own daily shipment receiving and processing for NYC boutiques, coordinating priorities and time across locations based on delivery volume and business needs.
* Unpack, count, inspect, and verify incoming merchandise against shipment documentation and advance shipping notices (ASNs); complete accurate receiving in NewStore.
* Identify shortages, overages, damages, and other delivery discrepancies; document issues and follow up with the appropriate teams through resolution.
* Prepare merchandise for the sales floor, including required labeling, security tagging, and replenishment, in partnership with store teams.
* Prepare and process outbound shipments, interstore transfers, and other approved merchandise movements, ensuring accurate documentation, system transactions, and shipment tracking.
* Maintain organized, safe receiving and stockroom areas, keeping product accessible and shipment materials cleared promptly.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control Across All US Boutiques**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor open ASNs, negative on-hand balances, and open or aging transfers; follow up with stores to research discrepancies and complete required actions.
* Coordinate and track weekly cycle counts, required recounts, and inventory corrections; support stocktakes and discrepancy research.
* Monitor damage processing and ensure merchandise is documented, handled, and removed from sellable inventory according to company procedures.
* Identify recurring NewStore inventory issues and escalate unresolved discrepancies with clear supporting information.

**Additional Operational Responsibilities**
===========================================

**Store Standards and Operational Support Across All US Boutiques**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Support consistent execution of the Operations Manual and maintain best practices for stockroom organization, merchandise care, and inventory handling.
* Review stockroom standards during store visits and partner with store leaders to improve organization and workflow.
* Provide hands-on guidance and operational retraining on receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and related NewStore processes.
* Ensure store teams check returned or handled merchandise before restoring it to sellable stock, following company procedures.

**PR and Special Merchandise Movements**
----------------------------------------

* Coordinate store pulls for PR requests, communicating requirements and tracking product pulls, transfers, shipping, and returns as applicable.
* Support end-of-season transfers to Outlet or E-commerce and other approved special product movements.
* Provide operational assistance to headquarters for PR, damages, or other product handling needs as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Experience in retail stock, inventory, logistics, or store operations; luxury or specialty retail experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and stockroom organization; NewStore experience preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through, with the ability to balance shipment deadlines and administrative responsibilities.
* Clear communication skills and confidence supporting and training store teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and inventory or point-of-sale systems.
* Ability to perform the essential physical duties of receiving and moving merchandise, with reasonable accommodation as applicable, and to travel between NYC boutiques; occasional store visits as needed.

*Wolford is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

jobs.description:
Description:

**ABOUT PROCURE ANALYTICS**

Procure Analytics (PA) is the leading tech-enabled group purchasing organization for MRO, Packaging, and Freight, leveraging $2.5B+ in buying power to deliver up-front and ongoing savings for 1,000+ member companies ranging from mid-size manufacturers to Fortune 500 corporations. Headquartered in Atlanta and owned by Genstar Capital, PA is in an aggressive growth phase with a rapidly expanding Packaging program.

PA serves as a strategic extension of our members' procurement organizations — driving adoption, managing supplier relationships, and delivering measurable, documented value at scale.

**The Packaging Program Today:** The Packaging program is one of PA's fastest-growing categories. With strong momentum and interest from our membership, we are building the team to ensure we stay ahead of the curve and exceed member expectations.

**THE ROLE**

As a Packaging Member Advisor, you will own a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts spanning a broad range of industries. Your members will range from independent companies to private equity-backed organizations and consulting relationships, reflecting the diversity of PA's membership base. You will serve as the primary point of contact for your members and a key driver of program adoption, realized value and impactful business outcomes. You will report to the Director of Packaging & Logistics and work in close partnership with others on the Packaging & Logistics team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Manage a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts with full accountability for engagement, retention, and delivered value.
* Develop deep knowledge of each member's organization structure, procurement contacts, site operations, packaging spend profile, and strategic priorities.
* Maintain a 3-wide, 3-deep relationship architecture — building relationships across procurement, operations, and finance at C-suite, director, and site manager levels.
* Lead standardized Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) covering spend consolidated, savings delivered, opportunities identified, and forward-looking member needs.
* Identify and execute packaging optimization opportunities with our supplier partners, including SKU consolidation, packaging rationalization, vendor switching, and adoption tracking.
* Build strong working relationships with PA's packaging supplier partners to identify member-specific optimization levers.
* Utilize technology tools including PowerBI, Salesforce, Trumpet, AI, and PA proprietary software to document member interactions, track opportunity pipelines, and highlight risks.
* Support new member onboarding by participating in implementation handoffs and ensuring a seamless transition from the implementation process.

Requirements:

**Experience & Background**

* 3–5 years of experience in packaging, logistics, or supply chain account management — you have owned a book of business and been accountable for results.
* Direct experience working with or selling into manufacturing, industrial, or CPG companies; you understand how procurement decisions are made at complex organizations.
* Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder environments — you can operate effectively at the C-suite level and the site floor with equal ease.
* Demonstrated track record of building proactive client relationships, not reactive ones; you have examples of identifying and acting on opportunities before customers asked.
* Prior experience with PE-backed companies is a plus — you understand how private equity ownership shapes procurement priorities and decision timelines.
* Exposure to packaging distribution, manufacturing, or GPO/indirect spend environments (Uline, Veritiv, 48Forty, Shorr, or similar) is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Analytical fluency: you are comfortable in Salesforce, Excel, and data tools — you use data to manage your accounts proactively, not reactively.
* Strong project management instincts: you can run a QBR, manage an optimization initiative, track deliverables, and hold suppliers and members accountable to commitments.
* Clear, confident communicator — written, verbal, and in presentations. You do not over-explain; you drive to decisions.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: you bring a sense of ownership and urgency to your work. You do not wait to be told what to do.
* Collaborative teammate: you escalate intelligently, share knowledge freely, and make the people around you better.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree from a competitive program required. Strong academic performance.
* MBA or advanced degree is a plus, but track record and results matter more.

**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation package
* Company subsidized medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) match
* Employee Assistance Program
* State-of-the-art, tech-enabled office near the Battery (Home of the Atlanta Braves)
* Flexible / hybrid work culture

jobs.title: Named Account Manager
jobs.description:
In this role, you’ll own the strategy, customer relationships and commercial growth of a portfolio of strategic accounts. As a trusted advisor to customer executives on AI strategy, you’ll help shape their ambitions, prioritize high-impact opportunities and develop a roadmap for enterprise-wide adoption. You’ll align internal teams to deliver measurable business outcomes, lead strategic expansion opportunities and proactively manage risks to customer success and the long-term partnership.

You will use customer usage, adoption, and consumption data to identify growth opportunities, expand use cases, and increase revenue across assigned accounts

This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic consultative selling skills with strong account management, commercial judgment, and a genuine interest in helping customers realize measurable value from AI.

Responsibilities

Account Ownership and Customer Relationships

  

* Own and actively manage a portfolio of existing Strategic accounts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned customers.
* Develop a clear understanding of each customer’s business priorities, AI strategy, use cases, organizational structure, and success criteria.
* Build strong relationships with customers across multiple levels, including senior executives, decision-makers, procurement teams, champions and users.
* Establish a consistent engagement cadence through discovery meetings, business reviews, strategic check-ins, and proactive outreach.
* Create and maintain strategic account plans outlining customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, commercial potential, risks, and next actions.

Growth and Expansion

  

* Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing customer portfolio.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, account activity, and business priorities to uncover expansion opportunities.
* Recommend appropriate products, features, commercial structures, and use cases based on the customer’s needs.
* Build and manage a healthy expansion pipeline while maintaining accurate forecasts and clear next steps.
* Lead the full sales cycle from including discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, negotiation, and deal progression.
* Consistently achieve or exceed expansion revenue, pipeline generation, adoption, and account engagement targets.

Adoption, Retention, and Risk Management

  

* Help customers maximize the value they receive from the company’s products and services.
* Proactively identify accounts with low adoption, limited engagement, unresolved issues, or potential churn risk.
* Develop clear action plans to improve adoption, rebuild engagement, and protect the long-term customer relationship.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products and use cases that support the customer’s evolving business objectives.
* Support renewal readiness by maintaining strong account health and ensuring commercial risks are identified early.
* Gather and communicate customer feedback, product gaps, competitive insights, and recurring challenges to internal stakeholders.

Customer Issue Coordination

  

* Take ownership of the customer experience when commercial, billing, product, contractual, or operational issues arise.
* Assess customer concerns, determine their business impact, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain clear communication with customers throughout the resolution process, including timelines, progress updates, and next steps.
* Escalate high-impact or time-sensitive issues through the correct internal channels.
* Ensure customer concerns are followed through to resolution while maintaining trust and accountability.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements that can reduce customer friction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  

* Collaborate closely with Management, Support, Solutions, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations teams.
* Coordinate internal resources to deliver a consistent and seamless customer experience.
* Ensure clear handoffs, ownership, and accountability when multiple teams are involved in an account.
* Share customer insights and commercial opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Contribute to team best practices, enablement sessions, account reviews, and continuous process improvement.

CRM and Operational Excellence

  

* Maintain accurate and timely records of customer interactions, account plans, opportunities, risks, and next steps in Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Keep expansion opportunities, pipeline stages, close dates, and forecasts current and reliable.
* Prepare account updates and communicate progress, blockers, and support needs to leadership.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of product capabilities, pricing, commercial policies, customer use cases, and the competitive landscape.
* Follow established sales, contracting, forecasting, escalation, and customer communication processes.

  

Basic Qualifications:

  

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in B2B account management, customer success, inside sales, renewals, or consumption-based selling within a SaaS, cloud, AI, or technology environment.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience with quotas, targets or revenue assignments

Preferred Qualifications:

  

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in B2B account management, customer success, inside sales, renewals, or consumption-based selling within a SaaS, cloud, AI, or technology environment.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience with quotas, targets or revenue assignments
* Demonstrated experience growing existing accounts through usage-led, consumption-based, or land-and-expand sales motions

Headquartered in Glen Mills, Pennsylvania, New Carbon Company dba Golden Waffles is the largest supplier of waffle irons and waffle mix to the hospitality and foodservice industry. The Company provides a comprehensive turnkey waffle program consisting of mixes, toppings, and flavorings along with waffle iron equipment and related maintenance to over 40,000 customer locations throughout North America and the rest of the world. The Company's renowned irons and mixes have been used in leading restaurants, hotels, colleges, corporate environments, and theme parks for over 85 years.

As a complete B2B2C solution provider for the waffle category, the Company enables customers the ability to offer their guests a consistently high-quality, delicious product at high margins without the typical obstacles associated with serving waffles. Golden Waffles’ well-established geographic footprint provides coast to coast coverage in the U.S. and a global distribution partner network that can service customers across the U.S. and in ~45 countries.

Golden Waffles employs ~270 associates with a geographically dispersed route delivery team of ~115. Over 80 distribution centers are located across the United States along with a waffle iron manufacturing and refurbishment center in South Bend, Indiana to ensure prompt distribution to all customers.

**Job Summary**

The Business Development Representative is responsible for creating and executing market growth strategies - identifying new business opportunities, expanding into new markets, and maximizing sales within the assigned territory. The Business Development Representative is a proactive sales professional with a strong entrepreneurial spirit and a proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.

**New Business Opportunities in Assigned Territory:**

* Partner with foodservice operators (restaurants, hotels, institutions) to grow waffle program sales and menu penetration
* Use your hospitality/foodservice network to open and expand accounts — from independents to multi-unit chains; Lead negotiations and close deals to secure new business opportunities.

* Present and demonstrate company products and services to prospective customers within the assigned territory.
* Negotiate contracts and close sales deals to meet revenue targets.
* Provide regular reporting on sales activities, pipeline status, and market trends to management.
* Plan and execute the installation of all new accounts ensuring a seamless new customer experience from start to finish.
* Coordinate new account installation for large accounts with the local route sales representative and the customer service team.

**Partnership Development:**

Build and manage strategic relationships with foodservice distributors (broadline and regional[AD1] ), operator groups, and key channel partners to drive menu placement, distribution compliance, and volume growth within the territory. Develop trusted, long-term relationships with restaurant operators, chefs, and multi-unit decision-makers by acting as a consultative partner focused on menu profitability, product performance, and operational ease.

**Revenue Growth:**

* Drive revenue growth by developing and executing plans to increase sales and market share.
* Monitor and analyze sales performance, providing regular reports and insights to senior leadership.
* Identify and address any barriers to growth, implementing corrective actions as needed.

**Brand Representation:**

* Represent Golden Waffles at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.
* Act as a brand ambassador, promoting our values and vision to external audiences.

**Position Requirements**

* 2–5+ yrs experience in foodservice sales, wholesale distribution, restaurant supply, or CPG[AD2] route/business development
* Deep understanding of foodservice operators, buyers, and menu cycles

* Evaluate inbound and outbound lead data to rank and pursue high-value foodservice accounts, ensuring time and resources are focused on opportunities with the highest likelihood of conversion and long-term revenue.

* Excellent organizational and time management skills.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Gallagher Security**

Gallagher Security is a global technology leader trusted by organizations to protect people, assets, and operations in complex environments. We’re looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative who enjoys connecting with prospective customers, generating demand, and creating opportunities that support our continued growth.

**The Opportunity**

As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll play an important role in our lead generation strategy, supporting the Canadian and U.S. markets. You’ll research target accounts, conduct outreach and outbound demand generation, respond to inbound interest, prospect across social media and market intelligence platforms, and qualify leads through email and inbound and outbound calls.

You’ll partner with sales and marketing to create and execute program and outbound lead generation campaigns, uncover new and existing sales leads, and turn early interest into qualified opportunities. Working cross functionally with sales, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll help create a positive first impression and build momentum throughout the sales cycle.

This is a hybrid role with 2-3 days in the Canton Atlanta office.

**What You’ll Do**

* Follow up on inbound marketing leads, qualify interest, and provide prospects with the right information at the right time.

* Research target markets, build prospect lists, identify key decision makers, and develop a clear understanding of customer requirements.

* Generate new opportunities through outbound calls, email, social media, campaigns, webinars, seminars, and conferences.

* Conduct discovery and qualification conversations, communicate Gallagher Security’s value, and deliver high level, solution oriented presentations.

* Schedule qualified appointments and demonstrations, then hand opportunities to Business Development Managers or Regional Sales Managers.

* Nurture prospects until they are ready to engage with sales, building trusted relationships as an early point of contact.

* Maintain accurate prospect, activity, and qualification records in the CRM and ensure effective follow through across the sales cycle.

* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and technical colleagues to improve campaigns, refine outreach, and support regional growth.

* Develop knowledge of access control, perimeter protection, intrusion detection, and Gallagher Security’s wider product offering.

**What You’ll Bring**

This role **requires professional fluency in both French and English** to communicate effectively with prospective customers across Canada. **Fluency in both languages is an essential requirement for the position.**

You’re an energetic, self motivated communicator who enjoys opening conversations, understanding customer needs, and working with others to turn interest into genuine sales opportunities.

* **Fluency in both French and English is required to support prospective customers across Canada.**

* **2+ years of successful experience in inside sales, demand generation, telemarketing, customer service, or a related field.**

* A four year college degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent relevant experience; a bachelor’s degree in business or a related area is preferred.

* Strong written and verbal communication, active listening, and the confidence to hold informative two way conversations with prospects.

* Demonstrated prospecting ability and experience using CRM systems; familiarity with sales outreach platforms is an advantage.

* The ability to explain complex topics clearly, tailor outreach to customer needs, and manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment.

* A collaborative, flexible, and responsive approach, with the ability to work independently and support a distributed team.

* A diligent work ethic, high integrity, resilience, initiative, and a strong focus on achieving goals and key deliverables.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**What We Offer**

* Career development opportunities, including the chance to learn from experienced sales professionals and build skills for future advancement.

* A collaborative, cross functional environment where your ideas and contributions can help improve our sales approach.

* The opportunity to represent a respected global security technology company and contribute directly to regional growth.

**Apply Now**

If you’re ready to build relationships, generate demand, and help create new opportunities for Gallagher Security, apply today.

jobs.description:
**Marketing Services | Chicago, IL | Full-Time | Local Travel Required**

**Pay Range: $65,000 – $80,000 annually, commensurate with experience**

**Join us — and do work that matters.**

We're a passionate team of change-makers, diverse thinkers, and problem-solvers. Our purpose: ensuring full access to quality living and championing the power of inclusivity. We proudly serve over 7,000 individuals with disabilities and behavioral health challenges, including those who are Deaf, DeafBlind, and Hard of Hearing.

If you're not looking for just any job — if you're ready to build a career where your work directly supports that mission — Anixter Center is the place for you.

**About the Role**

As our Community Outreach Manager, you'll be the face of Anixter Center to the schools and agencies that support young people and adults with IDD and mental health needs. You'll build and sustain a robust referral network that connects individuals and families to our transition and community-based services, and you'll make sure every referral ends in a successful connection. You'll be the primary point of contact for Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, Integrated Community Supports agencies (ISCs), Community Service Organizations (CSOs), and Community Alternative Unlimited units (CAUs) across Chicagoland, and you'll partner closely with Intake, Case Management, program staff, and Marketing/Communications.

This is a full-time, exempt role based in Chicago, with regular local travel throughout the Chicagoland area. A flexible schedule is required, which may include evenings and weekends as necessary.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and grow a referral pipeline by developing strong, lasting relationships with Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs.
* Conduct regular outreach through site visits, presentations, and one-on-one meetings with school staff, coordinators, and case managers.
* Represent Anixter Center at IEP/transition planning meetings, school fairs, community events, and networking functions to raise awareness of our programs.
* Serve as a go-to resource on our transition, IDD, mental health, and Deaf/DeafBlind/Hard of Hearing services, helping partners understand eligibility, intake, and program fit.
* Set up and maintain clear referral pathways with partners, documenting how to refer, who to contact, and what to expect at each step.
* Track every referral from first contact to enrollment in our CRM, and follow up with partners and families to close the loop. Work with Intake, Case Management, and program staff to make each handoff smooth.
* Develop outreach materials with Marketing/Communications, monitor referral trends and outcomes, and share what you learn about gaps, underserved communities, and new partnership opportunities with leadership.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Education, Human Services, Public Health, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (preferred).
* 2+ years of experience in community outreach, community development, referral or care coordination, case management, special education, or transition services (preferred).
* Working knowledge of the IDD and/or mental health service systems in Illinois, including ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs, and familiarity with PUNS (Prioritization of Urgency of Need for Services) and the IEP/transition planning process.
* Excellent relationship-building, networking, and communication skills, with the confidence to engage school administrators, educators, and agency partners, and strong organizational skills with a CRM or referral-tracking database.
* A valid driver's license, willingness to travel locally throughout Chicagoland, and flexibility to work evenings and weekends as necessary.
* An existing network in Chicagoland special education, transition schools, or DHS/DRS-affiliated service coordination agencies; experience working with individuals who are Deaf, DeafBlind, or Hard of Hearing (ASL a plus); and nonprofit, healthcare, or education-adjacent partnerships experience are all a plus.
* A genuine commitment to nonprofit, mission-driven work.

**Benefits**

Anixter Center offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, and generous paid time off and holidays.

**Why Anixter Center**

You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team committed to inclusion and accessibility, where relationships and follow-through translate directly into people getting the right supports at the right time. We offer a mission you can feel good about and the chance to be the connection between families and the services they need.

*Anixter Center is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing people with disabilities.*

**Ready to make an impact? Apply today with your resume and a cover letter describing your experience building partnerships or referral networks and your interest in our mission.**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator (12-Week Contract)
jobs.description:
**About Curfew Labs**  
Curfew Labs builds software that makes work easier. Our flagship, Curfew Suite, is a family of connected business apps for time, expenses, books, projects and signatures on one account. We build quiet, dependable tools that do the tedious, load-bearing work so people don’t have to worry when they step away.

**The role**  
A 12-week contract to find out where our marketing should go next. This is an analytics role more than a creative one. You’ll set up and run paid campaigns across our advertising channels, make sure every click and sign-up can be traced back to where it came from, and measure what each new customer costs us to win and what they’re worth. Then you’ll tell us, with evidence, which bets to make. Our team handles the creative; you’ll brief it, test it and say what’s working. Expect 20 to 40 hours a week, set together at the start, and a hybrid schedule from our Chicago office.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and own our tracking. Set a consistent UTM convention for every link and campaign, and put conversion tracking, ad platform pixels and analytics events in place. The goal is clean attribution from first click to paying customer.
* Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, TikTok, and OpenAI’s ChatGPT ads
* Track customer acquisition cost (CAC) by channel, campaign and audience, alongside conversion rates, return on ad spend and early lifetime value
* Analyze the customer lifecycle, from first visit to sign-up, activation and retention, using funnels and cohorts, and find the patterns behind who stays
* Design and run tests on audiences, offers, landing pages and budgets, with a clear hypothesis and read-out for each
* Build a simple dashboard and a weekly report that say plainly what’s working, what isn’t, and where to move spend
* Brief our team on creative and landing pages based on what the data shows
* Leave the tracking, the dashboard and a written playbook in good order, so the work carries on after the contract

**What you bring**

* Two or more years in performance or growth marketing, ideally for software or online services, with real responsibility for budgets and results
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads, and experience with or a strong interest in ChatGPT ads
* Strong command of UTMs, conversion tracking, pixels and attribution, and of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager or similar
* A track record of measuring CAC, return on ad spend and lifetime value, and of turning the numbers into decisions
* Experience with funnel, cohort and retention analysis; comfort with spreadsheets, and SQL a plus
* A habit of testing before scaling, and of reporting results honestly, including the ones that didn’t work
* A very organized way of working

**Contract details**

* 12 weeks, starting as soon as the right person is found
* 20 to 40 hours a week, agreed at the start based on campaign volume
* Hybrid: part of the week in our Chicago office, the rest remote
* $30 to $45 an hour

We work in the office and are open to hybrid schedules.

**Why Curfew Labs**  
We’re building business software around a simple idea: applications should work together naturally, so people spend less time managing tools and more time on the work that matters. People and AI work side by side at every stage of how we build and run the company: people set the direction and remain accountable, and AI helps us move faster. In this role, your analysis will shape where Curfew Labs invests next. Learn more about us at curfewlabs.com.

Pay: $30.00 - $45.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60625

Along the way, you’ll get hands-on experience with Salesforce, sales qualification, and the full sales process, plus training and coaching from experienced sales and business development professionals.
  
  
This is a great fit for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and energized by talking with people. Success in this role is measured by speed-to-lead, qualification accuracy, data quality, and how well inbound inquiries turn into real opportunities. Strong performers will have a clear path to grow into a Business Development Representative or other sales roles.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Serve as the first point of contact for inbound inquiries across phone, web forms, live chat, email, and internal channels, providing a professional and responsive experience
* Respond to new inquiries promptly, following established response-time standards
* Qualify inbound leads by asking questions to understand the prospect’s needs, project scope, timeline, and budget, using the qualification process you’ll be trained on
* Route qualified leads to the right Sales Representative based on assignment
* Write clear, concise handoff notes that summarize each prospect’s needs and conversation history
* Schedule and coordinate initial calls between prospects and Sales Representatives
* Enter and maintain accurate lead, contact, account, and opportunity records in Salesforce, including logging activity and keeping data clean
* Direct non-sales inquiries (existing client support, vendor solicitations, job seekers) to the right internal teams
* Follow up with leads who haven’t responded or aren’t ready to move forward yet
* Support sales operations projects and other team initiatives during slower inbound periods, such as Salesforce data cleanup, list building, research, and reporting
* Take part in ongoing sales training, shadow sales calls, and build your knowledge of our services and the digital industry

  
**Requirements**
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Communications, Marketing, or a related field
* 0–2 years of professional experience in a Sales or Business Development role, with a genuine interest in building a career in sales
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a friendly, professional presence on the phone and in writing
* Strong listening skills and natural curiosity, with the ability to identify prospect needs and ask effective qualifying questions
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks, keep information accurate, and stay composed in a fast-paced environment
* Self-motivated, competitive, and results-driven, with a coachable attitude and an eagerness to learn and grow
* Ability to juggle multiple tasks and stay composed in a fast-paced environment
* Collaborative team player who works well with others
* Comfortable learning new software; experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus but not required
* Interest in digital marketing, web design and development, or technology is a plus
* Professional appearance and demeanor is expected

Americaneagle.com provides its employees with an energetic work environment and opportunities to further develop their skills. Our dedication to growing our development team is how we can produce excellent sites and applications for our clients. We do all of this while maintaining a family value focus and pushing for a good work-life balance. The US-based salary range for this full-time position is $60,000-$75,000 per year. Within this range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Americaneagle.com, we are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package, a positive work environment, company activities and more.

Chicago North Territory
  
  
Break Into Pharmaceutical Sales with Pivya® at ImpactBio supporting Alembic Therapeutics

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Operations Coordinator keeps our orders, inventory and shipments moving. You will own the day-to-day path from purchase order to delivered and invoiced, working with customers, distributors, suppliers, co-manufacturers, carriers and our third-party warehouses. It is a hands-on role that combines logistics, order processing, inventory control, customer service and some accounting support.

\*\*Schedule: \*\*Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. No weekends.

Reports to: Operations Director

\*\*Compensation: \*\*$26 per hour- 40 hour week based on experience, plus benefits

**Key Responsibilities**

Order Processing & Fulfillment (approx. 30%)

* Receive, enter and confirm customer purchase orders from distributors, wholesale accounts and direct customers, including EDI orders.

* Release orders to our third-party warehouses and confirm ship dates and quantities.

* Process and ship daily e-commerce orders (Amazon and other online channels) and stock Amazon FBA inventory.

* Generate and send invoices through EDI and QuickBooks Enterprise; send advance ship notices where required.

* Track open orders to completion and resolve shorts, substitutions, backorders and pricing discrepancies.

Logistics & Transportation (approx. 25%)

* Schedule inbound and outbound freight (LTL and full truckload) with carriers and freight brokers; get quotes and pick the most cost-effective option.

* Book delivery appointments with distributor DCs and arrange customer pickups.

* Coordinate inbound shipments from domestic suppliers and co-manufacturers, plus imported containers, working with our customs broker and freight forwarder on documents and arrival timing.

* Act as the main day-to-day contact for our third-party warehouses (receiving, picking, shipping, inventory reports and billing).

* Prepare and check shipping documents: bills of lading, packing lists, pallet labels and case labels.

* Handle freight claims, damages and carrier delays, and keep customers informed.

Inventory Control (approx. 20%)

* Keep inventory records accurate across several warehouse locations, and reconcile warehouse reports against our systems (QuickBooks and SkuVault).

* Prepare purchase orders to suppliers for approval, then follow up on confirmations and ship dates.

* Track lot codes and shelf life; rotate stock first-expired, first-out (FEFO) and flag slow-moving or aging inventory.

* Support cycle counts, physical inventories and inventory adjustments.

Customer Service (approx. 15%)

* Serve as the first point of contact for customer, distributor and broker questions about orders, status, pricing and product information.

* Answer phone and email questions promptly and professionally.

* Process returns, credits and deductions, working with accounting to resolve them.

* Keep customer setup paperwork up to date (vendor forms, item setup sheets, certificates of insurance, food-safety documents).

Accounting Support & Administration (approx. 10%)

* Enter accounts payable (supplier, freight and warehouse invoices) and accounts receivable in QuickBooks Enterprise.

* Match freight and warehouse bills to shipments before payment.

* Run routine reports (open orders, inventory, shipments, sales) for management.

* Other duties as assigned, including general office support.

Qualifications

Required

* 3 or more years of experience in order processing, logistics coordination, inventory control or customer service in a distribution, manufacturing or consumer products company.

* **Working experience with QuickBooks.**

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills (sorting, filtering, lookups, basic formulas) plus Outlook and Word.

* Very accurate with numbers and data entry.

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.

* Able to manage many open orders and deadlines at once and stay calm when plans change.

* High school diploma or GED.

Preferred

* Experience in foodservice, grocery or CPG, ideally with broadline distributors such as Sysco, US Foods, DOT Foods or Sygma.

* EDI experience.

* Experience working with third-party (3PL) warehouses and scheduling LTL and truckload freight.

* Experience with Amazon Seller Central / FBA, ShipStation or SkuVault.

* Familiarity with food-safety documentation, lot tracking and shelf-life management.

\*\*\*The Huntington Resource is an Equal Opportunity Employer – All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of the individual’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), marital status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

new_jobs.title: Agency Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Konnect:**

Konnect Agency is an independent PR and communications agency helping brands build awareness, relevance, and momentum. Our work brings together earned media, creator partnerships, experiential marketing, social media, and compelling storytelling.

**The Opportunity:**

We're looking for a strong writer and highly organized Agency Marketing Coordinator to help bring Konnect's work, people, and perspective to a broader audience.

You'll connect the dots across our social channels, newsletter, website, award submissions, and marketing materials, making sure great work becomes compelling content and reaches the right audience.

Working with agency leadership and teams across the business, you'll gather stories, write copy, coordinate assets and approvals, and keep our marketing calendar moving. You should enjoy both finding the story and doing the follow-up needed to get it published.

**What You'll Do:**

**Write and develop content**

* Work with the social and digital teams to gather and help edit social posts, newsletters, website copy, agency announcements, case studies, and marketing materials.
* Turn campaign results, team insights, and agency milestones into clear, engaging stories.
* Support executive thought leadership by developing draft posts and articles from leadership's ideas.
* Adapt stories for different audiences and channels while maintaining a consistent Konnect voice.
* Check facts, results, names, and details before content goes live.

**Connect social, email, and website marketing**

* Maintain one editorial calendar across Konnect's marketing channels.
* Coordinate with social and creative colleagues to develop, approve, and publish content.
* Help produce the agency newsletter, including story selection, copywriting, asset collection, testing, and distribution.
* Keep website news, case studies, and team information current.
* Extend the life of strong content: turn a campaign success into a case study, newsletter feature, social series, and award opportunity.

**Coordinate awards and industry visibility**

* Research relevant agency, campaign, and leadership awards.
* Maintain a calendar of deadlines, requirements, entry fees, and submission status.
* Draft award entries and collect supporting results, visuals, and information from account teams.
* Coordinate reviews and approvals so submissions are accurate and on time.
* Help identify speaking opportunities, agency profiles, and other ways to showcase Konnect's expertise.

**General agency needs**

* Proactively gather campaign wins, coverage, photos, videos, and results from teams.
* Maintain an organized collection of approved marketing assets.
* Set clear internal deadlines, follow up on missing information, and flag obstacles early.
* Support updates to agency credentials, capabilities materials, and case study libraries.
* Track content performance, newsletter engagement, website traffic, and relevant inquiries; recommend practical improvements.

**What you'll bring**

* Approximately 3 years of relevant experience in marketing, communications, PR, journalism, or content.
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with samples that demonstrate your ability to tell a clear story.
* Strong organization and the ability to manage several deadlines at once.
* Confidence following up with colleagues at every level and moving work through approvals.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Instagram, email marketing platforms, and content scheduling tools.
* Comfort using Canva and collaborating with designers on graphics and simple video content.
* Initiative, curiosity, and sound judgment about what makes a story interesting.
* Comfort using AI tools to support your work, paired with strong editorial judgment and careful fact-checking.

This is a hybrid in-office role with 3 days/week in one of Konnect's hubs (Los Angeles, Chicago). Previous Agency experience in a commensurate role and award submission experience is preferred. As part of the consideration process, applicants will be asked to submit 2-3 writing samples; ideally including social copy, a newsletter, case study, article, or award entry.

Konnect Agency is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. new_jobs.description:
Procurement Coordinator

Osiopack- Anaheim, CA

Job Type: Full-time

**Be the Connection That Keeps Our Supply Chain Moving**

Osiopack is looking for a highly organized, proactive Procurement Coordinator to join our team in Anaheim.

This isn't a position where you'll simply issue purchase orders and update spreadsheets. You'll play an important role in keeping our international supply chain moving, communicating directly with overseas suppliers, monitoring production, coordinating shipments, resolving issues, and helping ensure our customers' orders arrive accurately and on time.

You'll serve as a key liaison between our U.S. team and our overseas manufacturing partners. If you're someone who enjoys staying on top of details, solving problems before they become bigger problems, and keeping multiple moving pieces organized, we'd like to meet you.

**What You'll Do**

As our Procurement Coordinator, you will:

* Communicate regularly with overseas suppliers regarding purchase orders, production schedules, invoices, priorities, and shipments
* Track open purchase orders from placement through production and delivery
* Monitor production status, lead times, and potential schedule risks
* Coordinate expedited orders and help resolve delays before they impact customers
* Obtain quotations and assist with supplier sourcing and purchasing negotiations
* Prepare and maintain purchase orders, RFQs, shipping documentation, supplier correspondence, and internal documentation
* Review supplier proposals, purchase orders, invoices, receipts, and related documents for accuracy
* Coordinate with suppliers to identify the best pricing and delivery options
* Maintain supplier cost information and monitor changes affecting procurement
* Work cross-functionally with Customer Service, Accounting, Production, Receiving, and other departments
* Obtain samples, inspection documentation, certifications, and other supplier information as required
* Coordinate rejected or nonconforming materials with suppliers
* Help identify and resolve purchasing, production, documentation, and logistics issues
* Translate supplier emails, documents, and reports when needed
* Assist with special projects and other procurement-related responsibilities

**What We're Looking For**

Our ideal candidate is:

* Bilingual in English and Korean speaking, reading, and writing **strongly preferred**
* Experienced in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or a related field
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple open orders simultaneously
* Detail-oriented and able to catch documentation or scheduling errors
* A strong communicator who is comfortable working with international suppliers
* Proactive, you don't simply report a problem; you help find the solution
* Comfortable following up persistently when information or action is needed
* Able to prioritize urgent requirements while maintaining accuracy
* Comfortable working across multiple departments
* Proficient with email, Microsoft Word, and Excel
* Familiar with inventory control, forecasting, and supplier lead-time management

**The Person Who Will Succeed Here**

You don't wait until a delivery is late to ask where it is.

You notice when a production date begins slipping, follow up with the supplier, understand what's causing the delay, communicate internally, and help develop a solution.

You understand that successful procurement isn't just about placing orders, it's about communication, follow-through, accuracy, anticipation, and accountability.

**Schedule:**

Monday–Friday

40 hours per week

On-site in Anaheim, California

**Benefits include:**

401(k)

Health insurance

Dental insurance

Vision insurance

Paid time off

**Interested?**

If you have experience coordinating purchasing, suppliers, production, or international logistics and you're looking for a role where your organization and follow-through directly impact the success of the business we'd like to hear from you.

Apply with your resume and tell us briefly about your experience working with suppliers, purchasing, manufacturing, or international supply chains.

**Femmes Against Violence Program**  
**Program Coordinator**

***Full-time, Union Position***

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Description:** Femmes Against Violence (FAV) is an 18-week, cohort-based program that promotes healing, agency, leadership, and self-determination among youth ages 14–21, including femme-identified and gender-expansive youth of color. The program integrates intersectional, liberatory frameworks grounded in Black feminist theory, Indigenous teachings, ancestral knowledge, collective care, and community accountability through interactive workshops, experiential activities, community outings, guest speakers, and youth-led action projects. Youth develop critical consciousness, leadership, advocacy, communication, and self-determination skills while engaging in opportunities to apply their learning through creative and experiential activities.

FAV also provides a wraparound support model that connects youth to mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources. ASAP Academic Program Specialist (Academic ASAP Student Advisor)

**POSITION DETAILS**

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017) and the Brookings Institution (2020). Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.

Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps motivated community college students earn degrees as quickly as possible, with a goal of graduating at least 50% of students within three years. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full-time study, mandatory tutoring, and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid-eligible students and free use of textbooks and monthly Transportation support for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP About ASAP Labor & Employment Law

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience supporting community college students.
* Experience coordinating tutoring or academic support programs.
* Understanding of barriers facing urban community college students.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with student information systems and data.
* Microsoft Office proficiency (Excel, Access, Word).

* Ability to work collaboratively across departments.

Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps students earn their college degree as quickly as possible, by removing the financial, academic, and personal obstacles that many students confront. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full-time study and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid eligible students, yearly textbook vouchers, and MetroCards for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP.
