new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Belfer Center for Innovation & Social Impact is seeking a highly organized and collaborative Program Coordinator to support the Center’s operations and growing portfolio of programs.

Reporting to the Senior Director and working closely with the Belfer Center team, the Program Coordinator will maintain the systems, logistics, communications, and administrative processes that keep the Center’s work moving forward. The role will also provide programmatic support across initiatives focused on leadership development, community building, civic engagement, and social innovation.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating across teams, and contributing to meaningful programs in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment. The ideal candidate is thoughtful, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing a range of responsibilities.

We welcome candidates from a variety of professional backgrounds. Previous experience in the nonprofit, arts and culture, or social impact sectors is helpful but not required.

Job Responsibilities Include:

* Support the day-to-day operations of the Belfer Center, including designated email accounts, calendars, files, contact lists, and shared team resources.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including scheduling, preparation of materials, agendas, notes, action items, and follow-up.
* Provide administrative and coordination support across the Belfer Center’s programs and initiatives, including research, written materials, presentations, and participant communications.
* Coordinate logistics for meetings, workshops, public programs, cohort gatherings, receptions, and other events, including room reservations, food and beverage, invitations, RSVPs, registration, materials, and on-site needs.
* Work with 92NY departments and external partners to support program and event planning and execution.
* Support communications and relationships with program participants, alumni, partners, speakers, and other members of the Belfer Center community.
* Attend selected programs and events, including occasional evening and weekend events, to provide on-site support.
* Work with the Belfer Center team and 92NY’s Finance Department to process invoices, payments, reimbursements, contracts, and related documentation, and assist with budget tracking and expense reconciliation.
* Maintain and improve internal systems, project-management tools, databases, workflows, templates, and recurring procedures.
* May be assigned other tasks and duties reasonably related to the role.

Experience, Education, & Skills Desired:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 2-3 years of relevant work experience.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and details simultaneously.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, polished work.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and partners.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities may evolve.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, and using project-management, database, email marketing, survey, registration, and customer relationship management platforms. Experience with tools such as Monday.com, HubSpot, Salesforce, Typeform, Mailchimp, or similar platforms is helpful.
* Previous experience supporting nonprofit programs, events, fundraising, operations, or administrative systems is helpful but not required.
* Interest in social impact, innovation, community building, and the mission and values of 92NY.

Work Environment & Requirements:

40 hours/week onsite at 92NY. Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm, with a one-hour unpaid meal break.

Occasional evening or weekend availability may be required to support programs and events.

Application Instructions

Interested applicants should forward a resume and a cover letter with salary requirements.

Due to a high volume of applications that we receive, we are only able to contact those applicants whose experience most aligns with the position profile.

Compensation Range

$50,000 - $55,000

*The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to the qualifications of the applicant, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.*

**About The Belfer Center**

The Belfer Center for Innovation & Social Impact is 92NY’s social impact laboratory, incubating and scaling initiatives that strengthen community, expand opportunity, and drive civic participation.

Since 2013, the Center has launched more than 20 initiatives that have collectively activated over 100 million people. Its largest initiative, Giving Tuesday, has grown into a global movement generating billions each year for organizations worldwide.

The Center operates with a start-up mindset within one of New York City’s most established institutions, combining innovation, community, and large-scale impact.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
Our growing law firm is seeking a creative, motivated, and results-driven **Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager** to oversee our digital marketing, social media presence, paid advertising, content creation, and community outreach initiatives.

We are looking for someone who can develop and implement marketing strategies to increase our firm's visibility, strengthen our brand, engage with potential clients, and help expand our presence in the communities we serve.

The ideal candidate will be creative, organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple marketing projects independently.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Social Media Management**

* Manage the firm's social media accounts, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube.
* Create and maintain a consistent social media posting schedule.
* Develop engaging posts, stories, reels, and short-form videos.
* Monitor social media engagement, comments, and messages.
* Stay updated on social media trends and recommend strategies to increase followers and engagement.

**2. Content Creation & Video Production**

* Create professional and engaging content highlighting our legal services, attorneys, firm activities, and community involvement.
* Film, edit, and produce short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.
* Design marketing graphics, flyers, advertisements, and promotional materials.
* Develop educational legal content in collaboration with our attorneys.
* Coordinate photo and video shoots within the office and at community events.

**3. Paid Digital Advertising**

* Create, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Google.
* Identify target audiences and develop advertising strategies to reach potential clients.
* Monitor advertising budgets and campaign performance.
* Track leads, engagement, and advertising results.
* Recommend improvements to maximize marketing effectiveness and return on investment.

**4. Community Outreach & Business Development**

* Identify community organizations, businesses, cultural associations, and local groups for potential partnerships.
* Coordinate opportunities for our attorneys to attend community events, legal seminars, and informational workshops.
* Reach out to organizations to arrange speaking engagements and presentations about our firm's legal services.
* Assist in planning community outreach events, educational programs, and promotional activities.
* Build and maintain relationships with community leaders and organizations.
* Identify new opportunities to increase the firm's visibility and attract prospective clients.

**5. General Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the law firm's services.
* Maintain consistent branding across social media, advertisements, websites, and printed marketing materials.
* Assist with website content updates and search engine optimization (SEO).
* Help manage the firm's Google Business Profile and online reputation.
* Develop creative strategies to promote the firm and strengthen its presence in the legal market.

**6. Marketing Performance & Reporting**

* Track social media growth, engagement, advertising performance, and potential client inquiries.
* Provide monthly marketing reports and recommendations.
* Develop strategies to improve lead generation and brand awareness.

Qualifications

* Experience creating and managing paid advertising campaigns.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and Google Ads.
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar content creation tools.
* Strong video editing, photography, and graphic design skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and generate creative marketing ideas.
* Strong organizational and relationship-building skills.
* Experience with community outreach and event coordination is preferred.
* Previous marketing experience with a law firm or professional services business is a plus.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is not simply looking to maintain social media accounts, but someone who is passionate about helping grow a business.

The ideal candidate will take initiative, propose new marketing ideas, develop advertising campaigns, create engaging content, and actively seek opportunities to introduce our law firm to new audiences and communities.

**Our goal is to build a stronger brand, increase our visibility, and connect with more individuals and families who may benefit from our legal services.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

* A current resume.
* Examples of social media accounts or marketing campaigns they have managed.
* A portfolio of content, videos, or advertisements they have created.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $69,800.00 per year

Benefits:

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative (2)
new_jobs.description:
*Hey there, it’s Bram, the Director of Sales Development at Carv. I know the application process can often feel impersonal, so I wanted to leave a quick note on why you should consider joining Carv. Besides the fact that we’re an AI company offering a strong SDR salary and great benefits, we’re also an early-stage business.*  
  
*That means things move fast: direction changes constantly, and what you sold today might be obsolete tomorrow. In my eyes, that’s the best environment to truly learn* sales.  
  
At *Carv, SDRs have regular conversations with founders, but also a team and leader (me) dedicated to their success.*

#### **Major Benefits**

* Base Salary is between $65,000 - $75,000 with OTE up to $105,000+
* 100% Medical Coverage
Company trip to Amsterdam coming in December

#### **Carv’s Mission**

Simply to make human recruiting again. AI is a major buzzword, we understand that and while its a very competitive market we think by augmenting recruiters to do more candidate focused work we can fundamentally change the way Recruiting is done by Enterprise level companies.

#### **Day to Day**

For the most part, SDR’s remain the same, Cold Calling, Emailing, Prospecting, LinkedIn - We believe the difference is in the margins, while being consistent and organized are major pluses creativity is essential for an early stage company. Some of our recent initiatives include delivering bagels to local prospects in person, going to trade shows and conferences, sending champagne to new job starters, and soon we will be sending cameo’s to prospects — All of these were SDR driven and you have the same chance to make an impact in this way.

#### **Challenges**

It’s not all roses though, we understand that. We are in a challenging environment, one where AI is EVERYWHERE and we are trying to do one of the toughest things you can do in sales - break into the US market. This job isn’t for the faint of heart but if you can be successful in a bootstrapped startup your value increases dramatically for the future.

#### **Who you are**

Someone with strong business acumen that is quickly able to understand our prospects and the value proposition of Carv. The people who thrive in this role know how to balance their time between structured repetitive tasks and creative initiatives that move the needle with high level enterprise accounts

#### **Additional Benefits**

* Unlimited PTO
* Company Stock Options
* Work laptop
* Personal Development Budget

new_jobs.title: Retail Inventory & Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Wolford**

Wolford represents the epitome of luxury and innovation in legwear and bodywear. With a rich heritage of knitting expertise and a global presence, we are committed to delivering exceptional quality, unmatched comfort, and a tailored customer experience. We empower our teams to exceed expectations, foster innovation, and contribute to the growth of a timeless, desirable brand.

**Join the World of Wolford — and help shape our future.**

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Retail Operations Coordinator is based at 609 Madison Avenue and is primarily responsible for the accurate and timely processing of shipments and merchandise movements across Wolford’s New York City boutiques. This hands-on role keeps merchandise organized, accurately recorded, and ready for the sales floor, allowing store leaders and brand ambassadors to focus on clients and selling.

Alongside NYC shipment responsibilities, the coordinator supports inventory accuracy, store standards, and operational processes across all Wolford boutiques in the US through inventory monitoring, process follow-up, and training support. The role partners closely with the Director of Retail, field leaders, and store leaders to identify issues, coordinate corrective actions, and maintain consistent operational standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**NYC Shipments and Merchandise Processing**
--------------------------------------------

* Own daily shipment receiving and processing for NYC boutiques, coordinating priorities and time across locations based on delivery volume and business needs.
* Unpack, count, inspect, and verify incoming merchandise against shipment documentation and advance shipping notices (ASNs); complete accurate receiving in NewStore.
* Identify shortages, overages, damages, and other delivery discrepancies; document issues and follow up with the appropriate teams through resolution.
* Prepare merchandise for the sales floor, including required labeling, security tagging, and replenishment, in partnership with store teams.
* Prepare and process outbound shipments, interstore transfers, and other approved merchandise movements, ensuring accurate documentation, system transactions, and shipment tracking.
* Maintain organized, safe receiving and stockroom areas, keeping product accessible and shipment materials cleared promptly.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control Across All US Boutiques**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor open ASNs, negative on-hand balances, and open or aging transfers; follow up with stores to research discrepancies and complete required actions.
* Coordinate and track weekly cycle counts, required recounts, and inventory corrections; support stocktakes and discrepancy research.
* Monitor damage processing and ensure merchandise is documented, handled, and removed from sellable inventory according to company procedures.
* Identify recurring NewStore inventory issues and escalate unresolved discrepancies with clear supporting information.

**Additional Operational Responsibilities**
===========================================

**Store Standards and Operational Support Across All US Boutiques**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Support consistent execution of the Operations Manual and maintain best practices for stockroom organization, merchandise care, and inventory handling.
* Review stockroom standards during store visits and partner with store leaders to improve organization and workflow.
* Provide hands-on guidance and operational retraining on receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and related NewStore processes.
* Ensure store teams check returned or handled merchandise before restoring it to sellable stock, following company procedures.

**PR and Special Merchandise Movements**
----------------------------------------

* Coordinate store pulls for PR requests, communicating requirements and tracking product pulls, transfers, shipping, and returns as applicable.
* Support end-of-season transfers to Outlet or E-commerce and other approved special product movements.
* Provide operational assistance to headquarters for PR, damages, or other product handling needs as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Experience in retail stock, inventory, logistics, or store operations; luxury or specialty retail experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of receiving, transfers, cycle counts, and stockroom organization; NewStore experience preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through, with the ability to balance shipment deadlines and administrative responsibilities.
* Clear communication skills and confidence supporting and training store teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and inventory or point-of-sale systems.
* Ability to perform the essential physical duties of receiving and moving merchandise, with reasonable accommodation as applicable, and to travel between NYC boutiques; occasional store visits as needed.

*Wolford is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

We're a passionate team of change-makers, diverse thinkers, and problem-solvers. Our purpose: ensuring full access to quality living and championing the power of inclusivity. We proudly serve over 7,000 individuals with disabilities and behavioral health challenges, including those who are Deaf, DeafBlind, and Hard of Hearing.

If you're not looking for just any job — if you're ready to build a career where your work directly supports that mission — Anixter Center is the place for you.

**About the Role**

As our Community Outreach Manager, you'll be the face of Anixter Center to the schools and agencies that support young people and adults with IDD and mental health needs. You'll build and sustain a robust referral network that connects individuals and families to our transition and community-based services, and you'll make sure every referral ends in a successful connection. You'll be the primary point of contact for Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, Integrated Community Supports agencies (ISCs), Community Service Organizations (CSOs), and Community Alternative Unlimited units (CAUs) across Chicagoland, and you'll partner closely with Intake, Case Management, program staff, and Marketing/Communications.

This is a full-time, exempt role based in Chicago, with regular local travel throughout the Chicagoland area. A flexible schedule is required, which may include evenings and weekends as necessary.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and grow a referral pipeline by developing strong, lasting relationships with Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs.
* Conduct regular outreach through site visits, presentations, and one-on-one meetings with school staff, coordinators, and case managers.
* Represent Anixter Center at IEP/transition planning meetings, school fairs, community events, and networking functions to raise awareness of our programs.
* Serve as a go-to resource on our transition, IDD, mental health, and Deaf/DeafBlind/Hard of Hearing services, helping partners understand eligibility, intake, and program fit.
* Set up and maintain clear referral pathways with partners, documenting how to refer, who to contact, and what to expect at each step.
* Track every referral from first contact to enrollment in our CRM, and follow up with partners and families to close the loop. Work with Intake, Case Management, and program staff to make each handoff smooth.
* Develop outreach materials with Marketing/Communications, monitor referral trends and outcomes, and share what you learn about gaps, underserved communities, and new partnership opportunities with leadership.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Education, Human Services, Public Health, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (preferred).
* 2+ years of experience in community outreach, community development, referral or care coordination, case management, special education, or transition services (preferred).
* Working knowledge of the IDD and/or mental health service systems in Illinois, including ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs, and familiarity with PUNS (Prioritization of Urgency of Need for Services) and the IEP/transition planning process.
* Excellent relationship-building, networking, and communication skills, with the confidence to engage school administrators, educators, and agency partners, and strong organizational skills with a CRM or referral-tracking database.
* A valid driver's license, willingness to travel locally throughout Chicagoland, and flexibility to work evenings and weekends as necessary.
* An existing network in Chicagoland special education, transition schools, or DHS/DRS-affiliated service coordination agencies; experience working with individuals who are Deaf, DeafBlind, or Hard of Hearing (ASL a plus); and nonprofit, healthcare, or education-adjacent partnerships experience are all a plus.
* A genuine commitment to nonprofit, mission-driven work.

**Benefits**

Anixter Center offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, and generous paid time off and holidays.

**Why Anixter Center**

You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team committed to inclusion and accessibility, where relationships and follow-through translate directly into people getting the right supports at the right time. We offer a mission you can feel good about and the chance to be the connection between families and the services they need.

*Anixter Center is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing people with disabilities.*

**Ready to make an impact? Apply today with your resume and a cover letter describing your experience building partnerships or referral networks and your interest in our mission.**

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager (CHI)
new_jobs.description:
***Who we are:***  
bread & Butter is a full-service communications agency with a fondness for all things food, drink and travel. We are a collaborative group of dreamers and do-ers. We combine intimate local knowledge with an extensive national network to craft clever and multidisciplinary communications campaigns tailored to our clients’ needs. We only partner with inventive businesses that inspire us and continually challenge us to think big, but act small.  
  
***Why bread & Butter:***  
We are Southerners at heart, always saying, “Please” and “Thank You,” and hustlers by trade. We believe everyone deserves a seat at the table and practice what we preach to ensure the spirit of hospitality runs through everything we do. We're not a company that wastes time—not yours, not ours. We are not too busy to talk, come by or think of new ways to increase long-term brand awareness. For us, there is little difference between work and pleasure because our work is our pleasure.  
  
***We’re Looking at You!***  
A Social Media Manager with bread & Butter is a digital whiz kid, go-getter, and many-hat wearer who is ready to roll up your sleeves and get to work. You can’t get enough social, whether it’s following the top foodie influencers, keeping up with the latest digital trends or trying the latest TikTok trend. You’re also obsessed with restaurants, wine, food products, destinations and hotels and most likely have been a waiter, front desk clerk, line cook or oenophile in a past life. You are the account dynamo, helping meet client goals by crafting a social media voice and channeling brand sentiment to build authentic, relevant, interactive conversations and relationships. A proverbial eager beaver, you meet or beat deadlines, stay ahead of trends and always look for a new way to skin a cat. You like to go big – because going home isn’t an option. You’re a problem solver, creative thinker and value the relationships you’ve built with influencers and trendsetters. A Social Media Manager for bread & Butter should be thoughtful, creative, a strong writer, possess an almost obsessive attention to detail and is the first to get in the mix when helping means the chance to learn more.  
  
***Available Opportunity:***  
A Social Media Manager for bread & Butter is responsible for managing the online platforms of clients and influencer programming on a daily basis. The Social Media Manager will serve as a representative of the company and works in tandem with the PR, Creative, and Digital Marketing Teams.  
  
***Here’s What We Need:***

* Located in Washington, D.C. or Park City, UT
* 3-5 years of full-time, post-undergraduate relevant experience in social media management and influencer marketing, preferably with agency vs. in-house
* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
* Appreciates the art of telling the client story through influencer partnerships and key messaging
* A passion for building and cultivating relationships with influencers in the digital space, ranging from Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and blog content creators
* Extensive knowledge of Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant social media networks.
* Experience with launching social campaigns for hotels, restaurants, food personalities and/or CPG food and beverage brands.
* Background in creative development, social media analytics tools, and campaign analysis.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing and handling multiple projects.
* Ability to peer and self-edit writing quickly, turning around social media posts in real time.
* Ability to identify strategic and creative social media collaborations, takeovers and promotions for brands and lead through steps to execute.
* Help develop and strategize creative influencer partnerships and alliances that keep clients ahead of the curve.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, responding to consumers and guests within a brand’s voice during daily community management practices.
* Media junkie - there’s no such thing as reading/watching too much. Bonus points for pop culture acumen.
* Love of a fast-paced environment and the satisfaction of a busy yet productive day.
* Flexibility and a desire for endless possibilities. b&B is a dynamic, ever-evolving company that thinks beyond black and white.
* Excitement for growth, new ideas, new ways of doing things and a place you’re excited to call home. Say yes!

  
***Working Conditions***  
On the whole, this is a hybrid, office-based role. A Social Media Manager will spend time in meetings and briefings. Occasional travel might be required for client visits and planning. This position is considered sedentary to light work, and employees are not required to lift or move heavy objects. Although a Social Media Manager's commitment will tend to be standard office hours, deadlines or the demands of a client may see the Manager working nights or weekends to ensure continued success. Must be authorized to work in the US.  
  
***Having Our Cake & Eating it too:***

* Generous paid time off
* Paid sick/personal time
* Birthday off (because who wants to work on their special day!)
* Endless summer Fridays (half-days year 'round baby)
* Flexible, hybrid schedule
* Work from any b&B office when you're in town
* Medical and dental + dependents
* Extended benefits (vision, life, disability, EAP)
* Generous maternity and family planning leave
* 3% contribution to 401k regardless of participation
* Cell phone reimbursement
* New business bonuses
* Employee referral bonus
* Weekly Wine Wednesdays (cheers with your local team!)
* Robust training program
* Mentorship program
* Local love (yearly giveback initiative)

  
***Compensation:***  
The annual salary range for this role is $65,000 to $75,000.

You’ll receive the training, tools, and mentorship needed to succeed while gaining real-world experience calling on healthcare providers.

* Hungry to succeed
* Open to coaching and feedback
* Willing to follow a structured plan
* Ready to put in the work to build something meaningful
